movies.title: Sinbad: Legend of the Seven Seas
movies.original_title: Sinbad: Legend of the Seven Seas
movies.cast: Brad Pitt, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Michelle Pfeiffer, Joseph Fiennes, Dennis Haysbert, Timothy West
movies.overview: The sailor of legend is framed by the goddess Eris for the theft of the Book of Peace, and must travel to her realm at the end of the world to retrieve it and save the life of his childhood friend Prince Proteus.
movies.overview_fa: سنباد، ملوان افسانه هفت دریا، از سوی خدای اریس، مامور به سرقت بردن کتاب صلح شده است. او باید در این حین به قلمروی خود رفته و دوست دوران کودکی خود، شاهزاده پروتئوس را نجات دهد.
movies.overview_source_for_fa: The sailor of legend is framed by the goddess Eris for the theft of the Book of Peace, and must travel to her realm at the end of the world to retrieve it and save the life of his childhood friend Prince Proteus.

movies.title: Mickey's Christmas Carol
movies.cast: Alan Young, Wayne Allwine, Clarence Nash, Hal Smith, Will Ryan, Patricia Parris
movies.overview: Ebenezer Scrooge is far too greedy to understand that Christmas is a time for kindness and generosity. But with the guidance of some new found friends, Scrooge learns to embrace the spirit of the season. A retelling of the classic Dickens tale with Disney's classic characters.
movies.overview_fa: عمو اسکروچ خسیس و تنگ نظر در شب کریسمس با روح شریک سابق خود و سه روح دیگر ملاقات می‌کند تا دوباره لذت‌های کریسمس را به یاد بیاورد…
movies.overview_source_for_fa: Ebenezer Scrooge is far too greedy to understand that Christmas is a time for kindness and generosity. But with the guidance of some new found friends, Scrooge learns to embrace the spirit of the season. A retelling of the classic Dickens tale with Disney's classic characters.

movies.title: Undisputed
movies.cast: Wesley Snipes, Ving Rhames, Peter Falk, Michael Rooker, Jon Seda, Wes Studi
movies.overview: Monroe Hutchens is the heavyweight champion of Sweetwater, a maximum security prison. He was convicted to a life sentence due to a passionate crime. Iceman Chambers is the heavyweight champion, who lost his title due to a rape conviction to ten years in Sweetwater. When these two giants collide in the same prison, they fight against each other disputing who is the real champion.
movies.overview_fa: وقتی «جیمز چمبرز» (رامس)، قهرمان سنگین وزن بوکس که به خاطر اذیت و آزار مردم متهم و محکوم شده، وارد زندان می‌شود، «هاچن» (اسنایپس) که قهرمان محفل غیر رسمی بوکسورهای زندان به شمار می‌آید، در وجود او رقیبی سرسخت می‌بیند...
movies.overview_source_for_fa: Monroe Hutchens is the heavyweight champion of Sweetwater, a maximum security prison. He was convicted to a life sentence due to a passionate crime. Iceman Chambers is the heavyweight champion, who lost his title due to a rape conviction to ten years in Sweetwater. When these two giants collide in the same prison, they fight against each other disputing who is the real champion.

movies.title: Crank: High Voltage
movies.cast: Jason Statham, Amy Smart, Dwight Yoakam, Efren Ramirez, Julanne Chidi Hill, Jose Pablo Cantillo
movies.overview: Chelios faces a Chinese mobster who has stolen his nearly indestructible heart and replaced it with a battery-powered ticker that requires regular jolts of electricity to keep working.

movies.title: Barbie in the Nutcracker
movies.cast: Kelly Sheridan, Kirby Morrow, Tim Curry, Peter Kelamis, Christopher Gaze, Ian James Corlett
movies.overview: The Mouse King casts an evil spell over Clara that causes her to shrink. Clara and the Nutcracker set out on an adventurous journey to find Sugarplum Princess, who has the power to undo the spell.

movies.title: Undisputed II: Last Man Standing
movies.cast: Michael Jai White, Scott Adkins, Ben Cross, Eli Danker, Mark Ivanir, Ken Lerner
movies.overview: Heavyweight Champ George "Iceman" Chambers is sent to a Russian jail on trumped-up drug charges. In order to win his freedom he must fight against the jailhouse fighting champ Uri Boyka in a battle to the death. This time he is not fighting for a title, he is fighting for his life!
movies.overview_fa: این بار قهرمان سنگین وزن بوکس، «جورج آیسمن» با یک توطئه به زندان می افتد و طولی نمی‌کشد که وارد مسابقات غیر رسمی بوکس در زندان می‌شود...
movies.overview_source_for_fa: Heavyweight Champ George "Iceman" Chambers is sent to a Russian jail on trumped-up drug charges. In order to win his freedom he must fight against the jailhouse fighting champ Uri Boyka in a battle to the death. This time he is not fighting for a title, he is fighting for his life!

movies.title: The Return of Jafar
movies.director: Tad Stones, Alan Zaslove, Toby Shelton
movies.cast: Scott Weinger, Linda Larkin, Jonathan Freeman, Dan Castellaneta, Gilbert Gottfried, Frank Welker
movies.overview: The evil Jafar escapes from the magic lamp as an all-powerful genie, ready to plot his revenge against Aladdin. From battling elusive villains atop winged horses, to dodging flames inside an exploding lava pit, it's up to Aladdin - with Princess Jasmine and the outrageously funny Genie by his side - to save the kingdom once and for all.
movies.overview_fa: علاءالدین در حال سازگار ساختن خودش با یک زندگی جدید و اشرافی است. در قصر فشار بر روی او برای ازدواج با پرنسس یاسمن زیاد است. بعلاوه پس از آن یاگو (طوطی جعفر) در برابر او ظاهر می‌شود و درخواست کمک می‌کند ولی هیچکس از دیدن او خوشحال نمی‌شود. اما با بازگشت جینی از سفرش به دور دنیا اوضاع شروع به بهتر شدن می‌کند. در این حین راهزنی سبک‌مغز به نام ابیس مال چراغ سیاه جعفر را می‌یابد. با استفاده از ابیس مال جعفر راه را برای بازگشت به آگربا با فکر انتقام از علاءالدین و دوستانش فراهم می‌کند…
movies.overview_source_for_fa: The evil Jafar escapes from the magic lamp as an all-powerful genie, ready to plot his revenge against Aladdin. From battling elusive villains atop winged horses, to dodging flames inside an exploding lava pit, it's up to Aladdin - with Princess Jasmine and the outrageously funny Genie by his side - to save the kingdom once and for all.

movies.title: Death Note
movies.cast: Tatsuya Fujiwara, Kenichi Matsuyama, Asaka Seto, Shigeki Hosokawa, Erika Toda, Shunji Fujimura
movies.overview: Light Yagami finds the "Death Note," a notebook with the power to kill, and decides to create a Utopia by killing the world's criminals, and soon the world's greatest detective, "L," is hired to find the mysterious murderer. An all out battle between the two greatest minds on earth begins and the winner will control the world.

movies.title: Cinderella III: A Twist in Time
movies.original_title: Cinderella III: A Twist in Time
movies.cast: Jennifer Hale, Christopher Daniel Barnes, Susanne Blakeslee, Tress MacNeille, Russi Taylor, Andre Stojka
movies.overview: When Lady Tremaine steals the Fairy Godmother's wand and changes history, it's up to Cinderella to restore the timeline and reclaim her prince.
movies.overview_fa: بانو ترمین به عصای سحرآمیز پری مهربان دست پیدا کرده و بوسیله آن به زمانی که سیندرلا کفش‌های شیشه‌ای را به پا می‌کند، بازمی‌گردد. او کفش‌ها را به پای یکی از خواهران ناتنی او به نام آناستازیا کرده و حافظه شاهزاده را از خاطرات سیندرلا پاک می‌کند و…
movies.overview_source_for_fa: When Lady Tremaine steals the Fairy Godmother's wand and changes history, it's up to Cinderella to restore the timeline and reclaim her prince.

movies.title: My Neighbors the Yamadas
movies.original_title: ホーホケキョ となりの山田くん
movies.cast: Hayato Isohata, Masako Araki, Naomi Uno, Toru Masuoka, Yukiji Asaoka, Akiko Yano
movies.overview: The Yamadas are a typical middle class Japanese family in urban Tokyo and this film shows us a variety of episodes of their lives. With tales that range from the humorous to the heartbreaking, we see this family cope with life's little conflicts, problems, and joys in their own way.
movies.overview_fa: داستان این انیمیشن در مورد زندگی روزمره یک خانواده ژاپنی به نام «یامادا» است. زندگی روزمره‌ای که اتفاقات زیادی را شامل می‌شود؛ از گم‌شدن یک کودک در فروشگاه گرفته تا روابط بین پدر و پسر، زن و شوهر، و ماجرای اولین دوست دختر-پسر خانواده که با طنزی شیرین و درعین‌حال باورپذیر تعریف می‌شود ...
movies.overview_source_for_fa: The Yamadas are a typical middle class Japanese family in urban Tokyo and this film shows us a variety of episodes of their lives. With tales that range from the humorous to the heartbreaking, we see this family cope with life's little conflicts, problems, and joys in their own way.

movies.title: Sex Is Zero
movies.cast: Im Chang-jung, Ha Ji-won, Choi Sung-kook, Yoo Chae-young, Jung Min, Jin Jae-young
movies.overview: Eun-sik tries to pass the state exam while studying in college after his military service. One day, he meets a beautiful woman Eun-hyo, and his life changes.

movies.title: Serenity
movies.cast: Nathan Fillion, Summer Glau, Gina Torres, Alan Tudyk, Morena Baccarin, Adam Baldwin
movies.overview: A group of rebels travel the outskirts of space evading the sinister Alliance regime. Their lives of smuggling and cargo-running are interrupted by a psychic passenger who harbours a dangerous secret. Soon, the crew find themselves being pursued by an Alliance agent who will stop at nothing to find them.
movies.overview_fa: در آینده ای دور یک گروه قدرتمند به اسم «اتحادیه» بر کهکشان حکومت می کنند. این گروه که بصورت استبدادی بر تمام سیارات تسلط دارد همواره در تلاش هستند تا مخالفان و شورشیان را سرکوب کنند. یک گروه از این شورشیان به فرماندهی کاپیتان «مالکوم» سوار بر یک سفینه قدیمی با نام «سرنیتی» سعی دارند تا از دست نیروهای اتحادیه بگریزند. در همین زمان دختری به اسم «ریور» که قادر به خواندن ذهن افراد است موفق می شود ذهن گروهی از سیاستمداران اتحادیه را خوانده و پی به اسرارشان ببرد. به همین خاطر او به کمک برادرش «سایمن» از دست نیروهای اتحادیه و به خصوص مامور بی رحمی به اسم «آپریتیو» گریخته و در ادامه آنها به سفینه سرنیتی پناهنده می شوند.
movies.overview_source_for_fa: A group of rebels travel the outskirts of space evading the sinister Alliance regime. Their lives of smuggling and cargo-running are interrupted by a psychic passenger who harbours a dangerous secret. Soon, the crew find themselves being pursued by an Alliance agent who will stop at nothing to find them.

movies.title: A Christmas Carol
movies.cast: Patrick Stewart, Richard E. Grant, Joel Grey, Ian McNeice, Saskia Reeves, Desmond Barrit
movies.overview: Miser Ebenezer Scrooge is awakened on Christmas Eve by spirits who reveal to him his own miserable existence, what opportunities he wasted in his youth, his current cruelties, and the dire fate that awaits him if he does not change his ways. Scrooge is faced with his own story of growing bitterness and meanness, and must decide what his own future will hold: death or redemption.

movies.title: Drag Me to Hell
movies.cast: Alison Lohman, Justin Long, Lorna Raver, Dileep Rao, David Paymer, Adriana Barraza
movies.overview: After denying a woman the extension she needs to keep her home, loan officer Christine Brown sees her once-promising life take a startling turn for the worse. Christine is convinced she's been cursed by a Gypsy, but her boyfriend is skeptical. Her only hope seems to lie in a psychic who claims he can help her lift the curse and keep her soul from being dragged straight to hell.

movies.title: 17 Again
movies.cast: Zac Efron, Leslie Mann, Thomas Lennon, Michelle Trachtenberg, Sterling Knight, Matthew Perry
movies.overview: On the brink of a midlife crisis, 30-something Mike O'Donnell wishes he could have a "do-over." And that's exactly what he gets when he wakes up one morning to find he's 17 years old again. With his adult mind stuck inside the body of a teenager, Mike actually has the chance to reverse some decisions he wishes he'd never made. But maybe they weren't so bad after all.

movies.title: Shutter
movies.original_title: ชัตเตอร์ กดติดวิญญาณ
movies.cast: Ananda Everingham, Natthaweeranuch Thongmee, Achita Sikamana, Unnop Chanpaibool, Titikarn Tongprasearth, Sivagorn Muttamara
movies.overview: When Jane and Tun run over a girl in a car accident, they speed away immediately from the crime scene. However, Tun, a photographer, soon discovers strange shadows in his photos, which unsettles them.

movies.title: Force 10 from Navarone
movies.cast: Robert Shaw, Harrison Ford, Barbara Bach, Edward Fox, Franco Nero, Carl Weathers
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: World War II, 1943. Mallory and Miller, the heroes who destroyed the guns of Navarone, are sent to Yugoslavia in search of a ghost from the past.
movies.overview_fa: در دوران جنگ جهانی دوم چند مامور حرفه ای با هم متحد می شوند تا دهکده ای که برای استراتژی دشمن بسیار حیاتی است را نابود سازند...
movies.overview_source_for_fa: World War II, 1943. Mallory and Miller, the heroes who destroyed the guns of Navarone, are sent to Yugoslavia in search of a ghost from the past.

movies.title: Antichrist
movies.cast: Willem Dafoe, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Storm Acheche Sahlstrøm
movies.country: Denmark, France, Germany, Italy, Poland, Sweden
movies.overview: A grieving couple retreats to their cabin 'Eden' in the woods, hoping to repair their broken hearts and troubled marriage. But nature takes its course and things go from bad to worse.

movies.title: Fist of Legend
movies.cast: Jet Li, Shinobu Nakayama, Chin Siu-Ho, Billy Chow Bei-lei, Yasuaki Kurata, Paul Chun Pui
movies.overview: Chen returns to his school when he finds out that his martial arts teacher has died. When he learns that his school students are harassed by some hooligans, he gears himself up to save them.

movies.title: Days of Being Wild
movies.cast: Leslie Cheung Kwok-wing, Maggie Cheung Man-yuk, Andy Lau Tak-wah, Carina Lau, Jacky Cheung Hok-yau, Rebecca Pan Tik-hua
movies.overview: Yuddy, a Hong Kong playboy known for breaking girls' hearts, tries to find solace and truth after discovering the woman who raised him isn't his mother.
movies.overview_fa: هنگ کنگ ۱۹۶۰، یودی پسر جوان و خوشتیپ توسط یک پیر فاحشه بزرگ شده است. زن که امیدوار است یودی را برای خود داشته باشد از فاش کردن اسم مادر واقعیش امتناع می کند. یودی در شهر به عنوان کسی که قلب دختران را ربوده و می شکند شناخته می شود. دو دختر به دام او می افتند که یودی با این دو ماجراهایی دارد...
movies.overview_source_for_fa: Yuddy, a Hong Kong playboy known for breaking girls' hearts, tries to find solace and truth after discovering the woman who raised him isn't his mother.

movies.title: Happy Together
movies.cast: Leslie Cheung Kwok-wing, Tony Leung Chiu-wai, Chang Chen, Gregory Dayton
movies.overview: A couple travels from Hong Kong to Argentina to revive their relationship but experience turbulence when both men's lives drift in separate directions.

movies.title: Surrogates
movies.cast: Bruce Willis, Radha Mitchell, Rosamund Pike, James Cromwell, Ving Rhames, Helena Mattsson
movies.overview: Set in a futuristic world where humans live in isolation and interact through surrogate robots, a cop is forced to leave his home for the first time in years in order to investigate the murders of others' surrogates.

movies.title: Ocean Waves
movies.cast: Nobuo Tobita, Yoko Sakamoto, Toshihiko Seki, Yuri Amano, Kae Araki, Jun'ichi Kanemaru
movies.overview: At Kichijōji Station, Tokyo, Taku Morisaki glimpses a familiar woman on the platform opposite boarding a train. Later, her photo falls from a shelf as he exits his apartment before flying to Kōchi Prefecture. Picking it up, he looks at it briefly before leaving. As the aeroplane takes off, he narrates the events that brought her into his life...

movies.title: Detective Conan: The Time Bombed Skyscraper
movies.original_title: 名探偵コナン 時計じかけの摩天楼
movies.cast: Minami Takayama, Kappei Yamaguchi, Wakana Yamazaki, Akira Kamiya, Kenichi Ogata, Yukiko Iwai
movies.overview: Once brilliant teenage detective Shinichi Kudo was given a poison that reverted him to a 4-year-old. He's adopted the pseudonym Conan Edogawa so no one (save for an eccentric inventor) will know. Now he's got to solve a series of bombings before his loved ones become victims. Who is this madman and why is he doing this? Only the young genius can save the day but will even he be up to the task?

movies.title: The Fourth Kind
movies.cast: Milla Jovovich, Elias Koteas, Will Patton, Hakeem Kae-Kazim, Corey Johnson, Enzo Cilenti
movies.overview: Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler, a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.
movies.overview_fa: نوع چهارم؛ فیلمی در سبک علمی تخیلی تریلر روان‌شناختی به کارگردانی اولاتوند اوسونسانمی و با بازی میلا یوویچ است. فیلم بر اساس اتفاقات واقعی است که در سال ۱۹۶۰ در شهری در ایالت آلاسکا اتفاق می افتد و به علت نوع خاص اتفاقات پلیس و FBI آن را مسکوت و بایگانی کرده اند. در آن سال ها گزارشاتی مبنی بر ربوده شدن انسان ها ارسال می شد. در سال ۷۲ یک دکتر روانشانس به بررسی اتفاقات پرداخت اما بررسی ها و تحقیقات او انتشار پیدا نکرد تا اینکه خود دکتر تایلر در سال ۲۰۰۲ مطالب را بازگو و افشا کرد. ماجرا از این قرار بود که در شهر نوم افراد محلی نوعی ارتباط روحی با بیگانه ها و فضایی ها برقرار می کردند که انواع مختلفی داشت نوع اول دیدن بود نوع دوم به جا ماندن مدارک و شواهد بود . نوع سوم برقراری ارتباط با بیگانه ها ، تماس یا برخورد مستقیم بود و در ارتباط نوع چهارم انسان ها توسط بیگانه ها ربوده می شدند…
movies.overview_source_for_fa: Since the 1960s, a disproportionate number of the population in and around Nome, Alaska, have gone missing. Despite FBI investigations, the disappearances remain a mystery. Dr. Abigail Tyler, a psychologist, may be on the verge of blowing the unsolved cases wide open when, during the course of treating her patients, she finds evidence of alien abductions.

movies.title: Ninja Assassin
movies.cast: Rain, Naomie Harris, Ben Miles, Rick Yune, Sho Kosugi, Randall Duk Kim
movies.overview: Ninja Assassin follows Raizo, one of the deadliest assassins in the world. Taken from the streets as a child, he was transformed into a trained killer by the Ozunu Clan, a secret society whose very existence is considered a myth. But haunted by the merciless execution of his friend by the Clan, Raizo breaks free from them and vanishes. Now he waits, preparing to exact his revenge.

movies.title: Evangelion: 2.0 You Can (Not) Advance
movies.original_title: ヱヴァンゲリヲン新劇場版：破
movies.cast: Megumi Ogata, Megumi Hayashibara, Yuko Miyamura, Maaya Sakamoto, Kotono Mitsuishi, Yuriko Yamaguchi
movies.overview: Under constant attack by monstrous creatures called Angels that seek to eradicate humankind, U.N. Special Agency NERV introduces two new EVA pilots to help defend the city of Tokyo-3: the mysterious Makinami Mari Illustrous and the intense Asuka Langley Shikinami. Meanwhile, Gendo Ikari and SEELE proceed with a secret project that involves both Rei and Shinji.

movies.title: Legion
movies.cast: Paul Bettany, Lucas Black, Tyrese Gibson, Adrianne Palicki, Charles S. Dutton, Jon Tenney
movies.overview: When God loses faith in humankind, he sends his legion of angels to bring on the Apocalypse. Humanity's only hope for survival lies in a group of strangers trapped in an out-of-the-way, desert diner with the Archangel Michael.

movies.title: Up in the Air
movies.cast: George Clooney, Vera Farmiga, Anna Kendrick, Sam Elliott, Amy Morton, Jason Bateman
movies.overview: Corporate downsizing expert Ryan Bingham spends his life in planes, airports, and hotels, but just as he’s about to reach a milestone of ten million frequent flyer miles, he meets a woman who causes him to rethink his transient life.

movies.title: Remember Me
movies.cast: Robert Pattinson, Emilie de Ravin, Pierce Brosnan, Lena Olin, Chris Cooper, Ruby Jerins
movies.overview: Still reeling from a heartbreaking family event and his parents' subsequent divorce, Tyler Hawkins discovers a fresh lease on life when he meets Ally Craig, a gregarious beauty who witnessed her mother's death. But as the couple draws closer, the fallout from their separate tragedies jeopardizes their love.

movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
movies.cast: Rooney Mara, Kyle Gallner, Jackie Earle Haley, Katie Cassidy, Thomas Dekker, Kellan Lutz
movies.overview: Teenagers Nancy, Quentin, Kris, Jesse and Dean are all neighbourhood friends who begin having the same dream of a horribly disfigured man who wears a tattered sweater and a glove made of knives. The man terrorises them in their dreams, and the only escape is to wake up. But when, one by one, they start dying violently, the friends realise that what happens in the dream world is real, and the only way to stay alive is to stay awake.

movies.title: Sucker Punch
movies.cast: Emily Browning, Abbie Cornish, Jena Malone, Vanessa Hudgens, Jamie Chung, Carla Gugino
movies.overview: A young woman, institutionalized by her abusive stepfather, retreats into a vivid fantasy world where she envisions a plan to escape. Gathering a group of fellow inmates, she embarks on a quest to collect five mystical items, blurring the lines between reality and imagination.
movies.overview_fa: دختری توسط ناپدری سنگ دلش که قصد تصاحب اموال او را دارد به یک تیمارستان فرستاده می شود. او در آنجا و در عالم خیال به همراه چهار نفر دیگر به موجوداتی وحشت انگیز مواجه می شود. به نظر می رسد اتفاقات عالم خیال می تواند بر عالم واقعی تاثیر بگذارد و بتواند او را از مهلکه ای که در آن گیر افتاده نجات دهد اما …
movies.overview_source_for_fa: A young woman, institutionalized by her abusive stepfather, retreats into a vivid fantasy world where she envisions a plan to escape. Gathering a group of fellow inmates, she embarks on a quest to collect five mystical items, blurring the lines between reality and imagination.

movies.title: Paranormal Activity
movies.cast: Katie Featherston, Micah Sloat, Mark Fredrichs, Amber Armstrong, Ashley Palmer, Crystal Cartwright
movies.overview: After a young, middle-class couple moves into what seems like a typical suburban house, they become increasingly disturbed by a presence that may or may not be demonic, but is certainly the most active in the middle of the night.

movies.title: Halloween II
movies.cast: Scout Taylor-Compton, Malcolm McDowell, Tyler Mane, Sheri Moon Zombie, Brad Dourif, Danielle Harris
movies.overview: Laurie Strode struggles to come to terms with her brother Michael's deadly return to Haddonfield, Illinois. Meanwhile, Michael prepares for another reunion with his sister.

movies.title: Emmanuelle
movies.cast: Sylvia Kristel, Alain Cuny, Marika Green, Daniel Sarky, Jeanne Colletin, Christine Boisson
movies.overview: An employee at the French Embassy in Bangkok invites his wife to join him – and enjoy the benefits of their open marriage.
movies.overview_fa: امانوئل ، همسر یک دیپلمات فرانسوی در بانکوک ، سفری را برای کشف جنسی آغاز می کند.
movies.overview_source_for_fa: An employee at the French Embassy in Bangkok invites his wife to join him – and enjoy the benefits of their open marriage.

Having invented a brother whom they claim to have ostracized for his disobedience, the uber-controlling parents terrorize their offspring into submission.

movies.cast: Louis Hofmann, Mala Emde, Katharina Stark, Frederick Lau, Maria Dragus, Trevor Magaya
movies.overview: A group of young people sets sail for the Mediterranean to save the lives of refugees — a mission that puts their ideas of law and justice to the test.

movies.title: The Unthinkable Daughter

movies.cast: Suzane Von Richthofen, Roberto Tardelli, Cíntia Tucunduva, Solange Azevedo, Daniel Cravinhos, Claudia Bernasconi
movies.overview: Decades of questions and a crime that shook Brazil. Suzane von Richthofen, convicted for the murder of her parents, tells the whole story in her own words.

movies.title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
movies.original_title: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy
movies.cast: Riley Kai Vargas, Terry McGurrin, Rob Tinkler, Kitai O'Garro, Josephine Nisbett, Grace Nicolaou-Wood
movies.overview: When Snoopy's beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.

movies.title: The Cheating Wife
movies.cast: Cess Garcia, Allison Ross, Vince Rillon, Primo Angeles
movies.overview: Two widows who find solace in each other and eventually fall in love. But when one of their supposedly dead husbands returns home blind, they are forced to hide their forbidden affair, testing the limits of love and loyalty.

movies.title: Hibla 2
movies.cast: Aliya Raymundo, Margaret Diaz, Albie Casiño, Ghion Layug
movies.overview: Two VMX queens, Aliya Raymundo and Margaret Diaz, play reunited childhood friends who share a memorable past and a complicated present: one is a liberated city girl, the other a sheltered country virgin, and both are surrounded by men eager to get a taste of their youth.

movies.title: Log 15
movies.cast: Jeanne Scurek, Jeff Ronan, Stephen R. Miller, Meg Moynahan
movies.overview: Driven to save her mother from Alzheimer's, a desperate woman documents her radical experiments to unlock the human mind, only to discover the footage she is recording is actively rewriting her own reality.

movies.title: Meethe Mein Kya Hai
movies.cast: Ritwik Bhowmik, Rohini Hattangadi, Ayesha Raza Mishra, Gaurav K Sharma, Tarana Raja, Abhay Kaul
movies.overview: A young widower's grief eases at a joyful Diwali reunion — until his sister's surprise marriage throws the family into chaos.

movies.title: Dancer in the Dark
movies.cast: Björk, Catherine Deneuve, David Morse, Peter Stormare, Joel Grey, Cara Seymour
movies.country: Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Iceland, Netherlands, Norway, Sweden
movies.overview: Selma, a Czech immigrant on the verge of blindness, struggles to make ends meet for herself and her young son, who has inherited the same genetic disorder and will suffer the same fate without an expensive operation. When life becomes increasingly difficult, Selma learns to cope through her love of musicals, dreaming up little numbers to the rhythmic beats of her surroundings.

movies.title: Jarhead
movies.cast: Jake Gyllenhaal, Jamie Foxx, Peter Sarsgaard, Scott MacDonald, Chris Cooper, Laz Alonso
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: Jarhead is a film about a US Marine Anthony Swofford’s experience in the Gulf War. After putting up with an arduous boot camp, Swofford and his unit are sent to the Persian Gulf where they are eager to fight, but are forced to stay back from the action. Swofford struggles with the possibility of his girlfriend cheating on him, and as his mental state deteriorates, his desire to kill increases.

movies.title: Absolute Power
movies.cast: Clint Eastwood, Gene Hackman, Ed Harris, Laura Linney, Judy Davis, Scott Glenn
movies.overview: A master thief coincidentally is robbing a house where a murder—in which the President of the United States is involved—occurs in front of his eyes. He is forced to run, while holding evidence that could convict the President.

movies.title: Beverly Hills Cop II
movies.cast: Eddie Murphy, Judge Reinhold, John Ashton, Jürgen Prochnow, Ronny Cox, Brigitte Nielsen
movies.overview: Axel Foley returns to the land of sunshine and palm trees to investigate the near-fatal shooting of police Captain Andrew Bogomil. With the help of Sgt. Taggart and Det. Rosewood, they soon uncover that the shooting is associated with a series of "alphabet" robberies masterminded by a heartless weapons kingpin—and the chase is on.

movies.title: All About My Mother
movies.cast: Cecilia Roth, Marisa Paredes, Candela Peña, Antonia San Juan, Penélope Cruz, Rosa María Sardà
movies.overview: Following the tragic death of her teenage son, Manuela travels from Madrid to Barcelona in an attempt to contact the long-estranged father the boy never knew. She reunites with an old friend, an outspoken transgender sex worker, and befriends a troubled actress and a pregnant, HIV-positive nun.

movies.title: Run Lola Run
movies.cast: Franka Potente, Moritz Bleibtreu, Herbert Knaup, Nina Petri, Armin Rohde, Joachim Król
movies.overview: Lola receives a phone call from her boyfriend Manni. He lost 100,000 DM in a subway train that belongs to a very bad guy. She has 20 minutes to raise this amount and meet Manni. Otherwise, he will rob a store to get the money. Three different alternatives may happen depending on some minor event along Lola's run.
movies.overview_fa: لولا تماسی از دوست‌پسرش، مانی، دریافت می‌کند. او ۱۰۰,۰۰۰ مارک آلمان را در یک قطار مترو گم کرده است که متعلق به یک آدم خطرناک است. او ۲۰ دقیقه فرصت دارد تا این مبلغ را تهیه کند و به ملاقات مانی برود. در غیر این صورت، مانی مجبور است برای تهیه پول از یک مغازه دزدی کند. سه سناریوی متفاوت ممکن است بسته به برخی رویدادهای جزئی در طول دویدن لولا اتفاق بیفتد.

movies.title: Three Colors: White
movies.cast: Zbigniew Zamachowski, Julie Delpy, Janusz Gajos, Jerzy Stuhr, Grzegorz Warchoł, Jerzy Nowak
movies.overview: Polish immigrant Karol Karol finds himself out of a marriage, a job and a country when his French wife, Dominique, divorces him after six months due to his impotence. Forced to leave France after losing the business they jointly owned, Karol enlists fellow Polish expatriate Mikołaj to smuggle him back to their homeland.

Forced to leave France after losing the business they jointly owned, Karol enlists fellow Polish expatriate Mikołaj to smuggle him back to their homeland.

movies.title: Three Colors: Red
movies.cast: Irène Jacob, Jean-Louis Trintignant, Frédérique Feder, Jean-Pierre Lorit, Samuel Le Bihan, Marion Stalens
movies.overview: Part-time model Valentine unexpectedly befriends a retired judge after she runs over his dog. At first, the grumpy man shows no concern about the dog, and Valentine decides to keep it. But the two form a bond when she returns to his house and catches him listening to his neighbors’ phone calls.
movies.overview_fa: آخرین قسمت از سه‌گانه فیلم‌هایی در مورد مشغله‌های جامعه فرانسوی، اینبار داستان در مورد یک مدل است که در میابد همسایه‌اش از تجاوز به حریم خصوصی مردم لذت می برد.

At first, the grumpy man shows no concern about the dog, and Valentine decides to keep it. But the two form a bond when she returns to his house and catches him listening to his neighbors’ phone calls.

movies.title: Spring, Summer, Fall, Winter... and Spring

movies.overview: An isolated lake, where an old monk lives in a small floating temple. The monk has a young boy living with him, learning to become a monk. We watch as seasons and years pass by.
movies.overview_fa: در دیری که روی دریاچه‌ای شناور است، پسربچه‌ای زیر نظر راهب بودایی پیری آموزش می‌بیند. سال‌ها می‌گذرد و پسر بچه، که حالا راهبی هفده ساله شده به دختر بیماری که مادرش او را به معبد آورده، دل می‌بازد و در پی دختر می‌رود. سال‌ها بعد راهب که سی سال از عمرش گذشته، از چنگ قانون می‌گریزد و به معبد پناه می‌برد؛ چون به خاطر دختر - که او را ترک کرده - مرتکب قتل شده است. اما پلیس او را دستگیر می‌کند. چند سالی دیگر نیز می‌گذرد و همان راهب، حالا چهل و خرده‌ای ساله، به دیر باز می‌گردد...

movies.title: Dracula
movies.cast: Bela Lugosi, Helen Chandler, David Manners, Dwight Frye, Edward Van Sloan, Herbert Bunston
movies.overview: A British estate agent travels to Transylvania to meet with the mysterious Count Dracula, who is interested in leasing a London castle. After Dracula enslaves and drives the agent to insanity, the pair return to London together, where Dracula, a secret bloodsucker, begins preying on socialites.

movies.title: All Quiet on the Western Front
movies.original_title: All Quiet on the Western Front
movies.cast: Louis Wolheim, Lew Ayres, John Wray, Arnold Lucy, Ben Alexander, Scott Kolk
movies.overview: When a group of idealistic young men join the German Army during the Great War, they are assigned to the Western Front, where their patriotism is destroyed by the harsh realities of combat.

movies.title: Wings of Desire
movies.cast: Bruno Ganz, Solveig Dommartin, Otto Sander, Curt Bois, Peter Falk, Hans Martin Stier
movies.overview: Two angels, Damiel and Cassiel, glide through the streets of Berlin, observing the bustling population, providing invisible rays of hope to the distressed but never interacting with them. When Damiel falls in love with lonely trapeze artist Marion, the angel longs to experience life in the physical world, and finds — with some words of wisdom from actor Peter Falk — that it might be possible for him to take human form.

movies.title: 48 Hrs.
movies.cast: Nick Nolte, Eddie Murphy, Annette O'Toole, Frank McRae, James Remar, David Patrick Kelly
movies.overview: A hard-nosed cop reluctantly teams up with a wise-cracking criminal temporarily paroled to him, in order to track down a killer.

movies.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
movies.original_title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
movies.cast: William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, Ricardo Montalban, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, Walter Koenig
movies.overview: The starship Enterprise and its crew is pulled back into action when old nemesis, Khan, steals a top secret device called Project Genesis.

movies.overview_source_for_fa: The starship Enterprise and its crew is pulled back into action when old nemesis, Khan, steals a top secret device called Project Genesis.

movies.overview: A renegade Vulcan with a startling secret hijacks the U.S.S. Enterprise in order to find a mythical planet.

movies.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
movies.original_title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
movies.cast: William Shatner, Leonard Nimoy, DeForest Kelley, James Doohan, Walter Koenig, Nichelle Nichols
movies.overview: After years of war, the Federation and the Klingon empire find themselves on the brink of a peace summit when a Klingon ship is nearly destroyed by an apparent attack from the Enterprise. Both worlds brace for what may be their deadliest encounter.

movies.title: The Big Blue
movies.cast: Rosanna Arquette, Jean-Marc Barr, Jean Reno, Paul Shenar, Sergio Castellitto, Jean Bouise
movies.overview: Childhood friends Jacques and Enzo share a passion for the danger of free diving. Jacques, following in the footsteps of his father, who died at sea when Jacques was a boy, harbors a remarkable ability to adjust his heart rate and breathing patterns in the water, with his vital signs more closely resembling those of dolphins than men.

movies.title: Star Trek: Insurrection
movies.cast: Patrick Stewart, Brent Spiner, Michael Dorn, Jonathan Frakes, F. Murray Abraham, Anthony Zerbe
movies.overview: When an alien race and factions within Starfleet attempt to take over a planet that has "regenerative" properties, it falls upon Captain Picard and the crew of the Enterprise to defend the planet's people as well as the very ideals upon which the Federation itself was founded.

movies.title: Star Trek: Nemesis
movies.cast: Patrick Stewart, Jonathan Frakes, Brent Spiner, LeVar Burton, Michael Dorn, Gates McFadden
movies.overview: En route to the honeymoon of William Riker to Deanna Troi on her home planet of Betazed, Captain Jean-Luc Picard and the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise receives word from Starfleet that a coup has resulted in the installation of a new Romulan political leader, Shinzon, who claims to seek peace with the human-backed United Federation of Planets. Once in enemy territory, the captain and his crew make a startling discovery: Shinzon is human, a slave from the Romulan sister planet of Remus, and has a secret, shocking relationship to Picard himself.

movies.title: Rebel Without a Cause
movies.cast: James Dean, Natalie Wood, Sal Mineo, Jim Backus, Ann Doran, Corey Allen
movies.overview: After moving to a new town, troublemaking teen Jim Stark is supposed to have a clean slate, although being the new kid in town brings its own problems. While searching for some stability, Stark forms a bond with a disturbed classmate, Plato, and falls for local girl Judy. However, Judy is the girlfriend of neighborhood tough, Buzz. When Buzz violently confronts Jim and challenges him to a drag race, the new kid's real troubles begin.

movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: After his long-time girlfriend dumps him, a thirty-year-old record store owner seeks to understand why he is unlucky in love while recounting his "top five breakups of all time".

Alongside his leading lady Ann Darrow and his first mate Jack Driscoll, they arrive on an island and discover a legendary creature said to be neither beast nor man. Denham captures the monster to be displayed on Broadway as King Kong, the eighth wonder of the world.

movies.title: About a Boy
movies.cast: Hugh Grant, Nicholas Hoult, Toni Collette, Rachel Weisz, Natalia Tena, Victoria Smurfit
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America, France, Germany
movies.overview: Will Freeman is a good-looking, smooth-talking bachelor whose primary goal in life is avoiding any kind of responsibility. But when he invents an imaginary son in order to meet attractive single moms, Will gets a hilarious lesson about life from a bright, but hopelessly geeky 12-year-old named Marcus. Now, as Will struggles to teach Marcus the art of being cool, Marcus teaches Will that you're never too old to grow up.

movies.title: The Killing
movies.cast: Sterling Hayden, Coleen Gray, Vince Edwards, Jay C. Flippen, Ted de Corsia, Marie Windsor
movies.overview: Career criminal Johnny Clay recruits a sharpshooter, a crooked police officer, a bartender and a betting teller named George, among others, for one last job before he goes straight and gets married. But when George tells his restless wife about the scheme to steal millions from the racetrack where he works, she hatches a plot of her own.

movies.title: The King of Comedy
movies.cast: Robert De Niro, Jerry Lewis, Diahnne Abbott, Sandra Bernhard, Shelley Hack, Frederick de Cordova
movies.overview: Aspiring comic Rupert Pupkin attempts to achieve success in show business by stalking his idol, a late night talk-show host who craves his own privacy.

movies.cast: Jean-Paul Belmondo, Jean Seberg, Daniel Boulanger, Henri-Jacques Huet, Roger Hanin, Van Doude
movies.overview: A small-time thief steals a car and impulsively murders a motorcycle policeman. Wanted by the authorities, he attempts to persuade a girl to run away to Italy with him.

movies.overview: In the last days of 1999, ex-cop turned street hustler Lenny Nero receives a disc which contains the memories of the murder of a prostitute. With the help of bodyguard Mace, he starts to investigate and is pulled deeper and deeper in a whirl of murder, blackmail and intrigue.

movies.title: High Noon
movies.cast: Gary Cooper, Thomas Mitchell, Lloyd Bridges, Katy Jurado, Grace Kelly, Otto Kruger
movies.overview: Will Kane, the sheriff of a small town in New Mexico, learns a notorious outlaw he put in jail has been freed, and will be arriving on the noon train. Knowing the outlaw and his gang are coming to kill him, Kane is determined to stand his ground, so he attempts to gather a posse from among the local townspeople.

movies.cast: Eddie Murphy, Judge Reinhold, Héctor Elizondo, Timothy Carhart, John Saxon, Jon Tenney
movies.overview: When his boss is killed, Detroit cop Axel Foley finds evidence that the murderer had ties to a California amusement park called Wonder World. Returning to sunny Beverly Hills once more, Foley reunites with Detective Billy Rosewood to solve the case. Along with Billy's new partner, Detective Jon Flint, they discover that Wonder World is being used as a front for a massive counterfeiting ring.

movies.title: The Celebration
movies.cast: Ulrich Thomsen, Henning Moritzen, Thomas Bo Larsen, Paprika Steen, Birthe Neumann, Trine Dyrholm
movies.overview: The family of a wealthy businessman gather to celebrate his 60th birthday. During the course of the party, his eldest son presents a speech that reveals a devastating secret that turns the night into a battle of truth and denial.

movies.title: Snakes on a Plane
movies.cast: Samuel L. Jackson, Julianna Margulies, Nathan Phillips, Kenan Thompson, Rachel Blanchard, Flex Alexander
movies.overview: FBI agent Neville Flynn boards a flight from Honolulu, Hawaii to Los Angeles, escorting a key witness to testify against a mob boss at an upcoming trial. An on-board assassin releases a crate full of hundreds of deadly venomous snakes in an attempt to eliminate the witness. Flynn and a host of frightened passengers and crew must band together to survive the slithery threat.

movies.title: Duck, You Sucker
movies.cast: Rod Steiger, James Coburn, Romolo Valli, Maria Monti, Rik Battaglia, Franco Graziosi
movies.overview: At the beginning of the 1913 Mexican Revolution, greedy bandit Juan Miranda and idealist John H. Mallory, an Irish Republican Army explosives expert on the lam from the British, fall in with a band of revolutionaries plotting to strike a national bank. When it turns out that the government has been using the bank as a hiding place for illegally detained political prisoners -- who are freed by the blast -- Miranda becomes a revolutionary hero against his will.

movies.title: Chocolat
movies.cast: Juliette Binoche, Judi Dench, Alfred Molina, Lena Olin, Johnny Depp, Hugh O'Conor
movies.overview: In the winter of 1959, a single mother and her young daughter arrive in a rural French town, where they open an unusual chocolate shop that disrupts the moral fiber of the strictly Catholic townsfolk and mayor.

movies.overview_source_for_fa: In the winter of 1959, a single mother and her young daughter arrive in a rural French town, where they open an unusual chocolate shop that disrupts the moral fiber of the strictly Catholic townsfolk and mayor.

movies.title: Who's Afraid of Virginia Woolf?
movies.fa_title: چه کسی از ویرجینیا وولف می ترسد؟
movies.cast: Elizabeth Taylor, Richard Burton, George Segal, Sandy Dennis, Agnes Flanagan, Frank Flanagan
movies.overview: A history professor and his wife entertain a young couple who are new to the university's faculty. As the drinks flow, secrets come to light, and the middle-aged couple unload onto their guests the full force of the bitterness, dysfunction, and animosity that defines their marriage.
movies.overview_fa: مارتا (الیزابت تیلر) و جرج (ریچارد برتن) زوج میانسالی هستند که زوج جوانی را نیمه شب به خانه شان دعوت می کنند. این فرصتیست دوباره تا عقده های چندین ساله آنها نمایان شود ...
movies.overview_source_for_fa: A history professor and his wife entertain a young couple who are new to the university's faculty. As the drinks flow, secrets come to light, and the middle-aged couple unload onto their guests the full force of the bitterness, dysfunction, and animosity that defines their marriage.

movies.title: Driving Miss Daisy
movies.cast: Morgan Freeman, Jessica Tandy, Dan Aykroyd, Patti LuPone, Esther Rolle, Joann Havrilla
movies.country: United States of America, United Kingdom
movies.overview: The story of an old Jewish widow named Daisy Werthan and her relationship with her black chauffeur, Hoke. From an initial mere work relationship grew in 25 years a strong friendship between the two very different characters, in a time when those types of relationships were shunned.

movies.title: The Straight Story
movies.cast: Richard Farnsworth, Sissy Spacek, Jane Galloway Heitz, Joseph A. Carpenter, Donald Wiegert, Tracey Maloney
movies.country: United States of America, United Kingdom, France
movies.overview: Retired farmer and widower Alvin Straight learns one day that his estranged brother Lyle has suffered a severe stroke. Alvin is determined to make things right with Lyle while he still can, but his brother lives in Wisconsin, while Alvin is stuck in Iowa with no car and no driver's license. He then has the idea of making the trip on his old lawnmower, thus beginning a picturesque and at times deeply spiritual odyssey.

movies.title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
movies.original_title: The Life Aquatic with Steve Zissou
movies.fa_title: زندگی آبزی همراه با استیو زیسو
movies.cast: Bill Murray, Owen Wilson, Cate Blanchett, Anjelica Huston, Willem Dafoe, Jeff Goldblum
movies.overview: Renowned oceanographer Steve Zissou has sworn vengeance upon the rare shark that devoured a member of his crew. In addition to his regular team, he is joined on his boat by Ned, a man who believes Zissou to be his father, and Jane, a journalist pregnant by a married man. They travel the sea, all too often running into pirates and, perhaps more traumatically, various figures from Zissou's past, including his estranged wife, Eleanor.

movies.title: Cube
movies.cast: Nicole De Boer, Nicky Guadagni, Maurice Dean Wint, David Hewlett, Andrew Miller, Wayne Robson
movies.overview: A group of strangers find themselves trapped in a maze-like prison. It soon becomes clear that each of them possesses the peculiar skills necessary to escape, if they don't wind up dead first.

movies.title: My Own Private Idaho
movies.cast: River Phoenix, Keanu Reeves, James Russo, William Richert, Rodney Harvey, Chiara Caselli
movies.overview: Mike Waters is a hustler afflicted with narcolepsy. Scott Favor is the rebellious son of a mayor. Together, the two travel from Portland, Oregon to Idaho and finally to the coast of Italy in a quest to find Mike's estranged mother. Along the way they turn tricks for money and drugs, eventually attracting the attention of a wealthy benefactor and sexual deviant.

movies.title: 21 Grams
movies.cast: Sean Penn, Naomi Watts, Benicio del Toro, Charlotte Gainsbourg, Danny Huston, Melissa Leo
movies.overview: Paul Rivers, an ailing mathematician lovelessly married to an English émigré; Christina Peck, an upper-middle-class suburban housewife and mother of two girls; and Jack Jordan, a born-again ex-con, are brought together by a terrible accident that changes their lives.

movies.title: Cléo from 5 to 7
movies.cast: Corinne Marchand, Antoine Bourseiller, Dominique Davray, Dorothée Blanck, Michel Legrand, José Luis de Vilallonga
movies.overview: Agnès Varda eloquently captures Paris in the sixties with this real-time portrait of a singer set adrift in the city as she awaits test results of a biopsy. A chronicle of the minutes of one woman’s life, Cléo from 5 to 7 is a spirited mix of vivid vérité and melodrama, featuring a score by Michel Legrand and cameos by Jean-Luc Godard and Anna Karina.

movies.title: D.E.B.S.
movies.cast: Sara Foster, Jordana Brewster, Meagan Good, Devon Aoki, Jill Ritchie, Geoff Stults
movies.overview: The star of a team of teenage crime fighters falls for the alluring villainess she must bring to justice.

movies.title: The Poseidon Adventure
movies.cast: Gene Hackman, Ernest Borgnine, Stella Stevens, Shelley Winters, Jack Albertson, Red Buttons
movies.overview: When their ocean liner capsizes, a group of passengers struggle to survive and escape.

movies.title: Jaws 2
movies.cast: Roy Scheider, Lorraine Gary, Murray Hamilton, Joseph Mascolo, Jeffrey Kramer, Collin Wilcox Paxton
movies.overview: Police chief Brody must protect the citizens of Amity after a second monstrous shark begins terrorizing the waters.

movies.title: The Hours
movies.cast: Nicole Kidman, Julianne Moore, Meryl Streep, Stephen Dillane, Jack Rovello, Ed Harris
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: The story of three women searching for more potent, meaningful lives. Each is alive at a different time and place, all are linked by their yearnings and their fears. Their stories intertwine, and finally come together in a surprising, transcendent moment of shared recognition.
movies.overview_fa: سال ۱۹۵۱. لارا براون (جولیان مور) زن بارداری است، که قصد دارد یک مهمانی برای شوهرش ترتیب دهد، اما نمی تواند دست از خواندن رمانخانم دالووی بردارد. کلاریسا وان نیز زنی در زمان حاضر است که یک مهمانی برای دوستش ریچارد، نویسنده ای مشهور که مبتلا به ایدز است، تدارک دیده. این دو ماجرا بطور همزمان به کار و زندگی ویرجینا وولف، کسی که رمان خانم دالووی را می نویسد، متصل هستند.
movies.overview_source_for_fa: The story of three women searching for more potent, meaningful lives. Each is alive at a different time and place, all are linked by their yearnings and their fears. Their stories intertwine, and finally come together in a surprising, transcendent moment of shared recognition.

movies.title: Downfall
movies.cast: Bruno Ganz, Alexandra Maria Lara, Corinna Harfouch, Ulrich Matthes, Juliane Köhler, Heino Ferch
movies.overview: In April of 1945, Germany stands at the brink of defeat with the Russian Army closing in from the east and the Allied Expeditionary Force attacking from the west. In Berlin, capital of the Third Reich, Adolf Hitler proclaims that Germany will still achieve victory and orders his generals and advisers to fight to the last man. When the end finally does come, and Hitler lies dead by his own hand, what is left of his military must find a way to end the killing that is the Battle of Berlin, and lay down their arms in surrender.
movies.overview_fa: فیلمی در ژانر درام جنگی، ساخته الیور هرشبیگل محصول سال ۲۰۰۴ است. سقوط بر اساس کتاب پناهگاه هیتلر تراودل یونگه، کتاب تا آخرین ساعت ملیسا مولر، کتاب هیتلر یوآخیم فست، خاطرات آلبرت اشپر و ارنست-گونتر باده روایت شده است. سقوط دوازده روز آخر زندگی آدولف هیتلر یعنی از ۱۷ تا اواخر آوریل سال ۱۹۴۵ میلادی را در سنگر زیرزمینی فرماندهی او به تصویر کشیده است. در این مرحله، فیلم از فروریختن ماشین نظامی و دستگاه سیاسی عظیم رژیم نازی آلمان آن پرده برمی‌دارد. سقوط از فیلم‌های پر هزینه تاریخ سینمای آلمان به شمار می‌رود. سقوط در اسکار ۲۰۰۴ نامزد جایزه بهترین فیلم خارجی‌زبان شد. امپایر این فیلم را در لیست صد فیلم برتر تاریخ سینمای جهان قرار داد  ترجمه از رضا بهادری
movies.overview_source_for_fa: In April of 1945, Germany stands at the brink of defeat with the Russian Army closing in from the east and the Allied Expeditionary Force attacking from the west. In Berlin, capital of the Third Reich, Adolf Hitler proclaims that Germany will still achieve victory and orders his generals and advisers to fight to the last man. When the end finally does come, and Hitler lies dead by his own hand, what is left of his military must find a way to end the killing that is the Battle of Berlin, and lay down their arms in surrender.

movies.title: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
movies.original_title: Butch Cassidy and the Sundance Kid
movies.fa_title: بوچ کاسدی و بچه‌ ی ساندنس
movies.cast: Paul Newman, Robert Redford, Katharine Ross, Strother Martin, Henry Jones, Jeff Corey
movies.overview: As the west rapidly becomes civilized, a pair of outlaws in 1890s Wyoming find themselves pursued by a posse and decide to flee to South America in hopes of evading the law.
movies.overview_fa: داستان فیلم در مورد دو دزد و راهزن به نامهای «بوچ» و «ساندنس» است که به قطارها دستبرد می‌زنند. اما یکی از سرقت هایشان طبق برنامه پیش نمی رود و گروهی از مردان قانون تا دندان مسلح، شروع به تعقیب آن دو می کنند. وقتی آن دو می فهمند که این گروه تصمیم ندارند دست از تعقیب بردارند، تصمیم می گیرند به بولیوی بروند.
movies.overview_source_for_fa: As the west rapidly becomes civilized, a pair of outlaws in 1890s Wyoming find themselves pursued by a posse and decide to flee to South America in hopes of evading the law.

movies.title: M*A*S*H
movies.cast: Donald Sutherland, Elliott Gould, Tom Skerritt, Sally Kellerman, Robert Duvall, Roger Bowen
movies.overview: One of the world's most acclaimed comedies, M*A*S*H focuses on three Korean War Army surgeons brilliantly brought to life by Donald Sutherland, Tom Skerritt and Elliott Gould. Though highly skilled and deeply dedicated, they adopt a hilarious, lunatic lifestyle as an antidote to the tragedies of their Mobile Army Surgical Hospital, and in the process infuriate Army bureaucrats. Robert Duvall, Gary Burghoff and Sally Kellerman co-star as a sanctimonious Major, an other-worldly Corporal, and a self-righteous yet lusty nurse.

movies.title: Saw IV
movies.cast: Tobin Bell, Costas Mandylor, Scott Patterson, Betsy Russell, Lyriq Bent, Athena Karkanis
movies.overview: Despite Jigsaw's death, and in order to save the lives of two of his colleagues, Lieutenant Rigg is forced to take part in a new game, which promises to test him to the limit.
movies.overview_fa: جیگسا و شاگردش آماندا مرده‌اند. حال، در پی خبر قتل کارآگاه کری، دو تحلیلگر با تجربه اف‌بی‌آی به نام‌های مامور استراهم و مامور پرز به محیط وحشت‌زده می‌آیند تا به کارآگاه با سابقه هافمن در وارسی آخرین بازمانده‌های رعب‌آور جیگسا و قرار دادن تکه‌های معما کنار هم کمک کنند. با این حال، وقتی فرمانده گروه ضربت به‌نام ریگ ربوده شده و وارد یک بازی می‌شود، آخرین پلیسی که تماسی با جیگسا نداشته، تنها نود دقیقه فرصت دارد تا با غلبه بر مجموعه‌ای از تله‌های دیوانه‌وار، دوست قدیمی‌اش را نجات دهد یا با پیامدهای مرگباری مواجه شود.
movies.overview_source_for_fa: Despite Jigsaw's death, and in order to save the lives of two of his colleagues, Lieutenant Rigg is forced to take part in a new game, which promises to test him to the limit.

movies.title: Annie Hall
movies.cast: Diane Keaton, Woody Allen, Tony Roberts, Carol Kane, Paul Simon, Shelley Duvall
movies.overview: New York comedian Alvy Singer falls in love with the ditsy Annie Hall.
movies.overview_fa: «آلوی سینگر»، کمدین موفق که دو بار ازدواج کرده، اکنون تنها در منهتن زندگی می کند. او وقتش را صرف کار حرفه ای، رفتن به سینما و مراجعه به روان کاو می کند. تا این که در سال ۱۹۷۵، پس از شانزده سال مراجعه به روان کاو، «آلوی» با دختری به نام «آنی هال»  شنا می شود...
movies.overview_source_for_fa: New York comedian Alvy Singer falls in love with the ditsy Annie Hall.

movies.title: The Piano
movies.cast: Holly Hunter, Harvey Keitel, Sam Neill, Anna Paquin, Cliff Curtis, Kerry Walker
movies.overview: When an arranged marriage brings Ada and her spirited pre-teen daughter Flora to the wilderness of 19th-century New Zealand, she finds herself locked in a battle of wills with both her controlling husband and a rugged frontiersman to whom she develops a forbidden attraction.

movies.title: The Last Emperor
movies.cast: John Lone, Joan Chen, Peter O'Toole, Ruocheng Ying, Victor Wong, Dennis Dun
movies.overview: A dramatic history of Pu Yi, the last of the Emperors of China, from his lofty birth and brief reign in the Forbidden City, the object of worship by half a billion people; through his abdication, his decline and dissolute lifestyle; his exploitation by the invading Japanese, and finally to his obscure existence as just another peasant worker in the People's Republic.

movies.title: Braindead
movies.cast: Timothy Balme, Diana Peñalver, Elizabeth Moody, Ian Watkin, Brenda Kendall, Stuart Devenie
movies.overview: When a Sumatran rat-monkey bites Lionel Cosgrove's mother, she's transformed into a zombie and begins killing (and transforming) the entire town while Lionel races to keep things under control.

movies.title: Gandhi
movies.cast: Ben Kingsley, Candice Bergen, Edward Fox, John Gielgud, Trevor Howard, John Mills
movies.overview: In the early years of the 20th century, Mohandas K. Gandhi, a British-trained lawyer, forsakes all worldly possessions to take up the cause of Indian independence. Faced with armed resistance from the British government, Gandhi adopts a policy of 'passive resistance', endeavouring to win freedom for his people without resorting to bloodshed.

movies.title: The Omen
movies.cast: Gregory Peck, Lee Remick, David Warner, Billie Whitelaw, Harvey Stephens, Patrick Troughton
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: Immediately after their miscarriage, the US diplomat Robert Thorn adopts the newborn Damien without the knowledge of his wife. Yet what he doesn’t know is that their new son is the son of the devil.

movies.title: Good Morning, Vietnam
movies.cast: Robin Williams, Forest Whitaker, Tom T. Tran, Chintara Sukapatana, Bruno Kirby, Robert Wuhl
movies.overview: A disk jockey goes to Vietnam to work for the Armed Forces Radio Service. While he becomes popular among the troops, his superiors disapprove of his humor.

movies.cast: Tony Leung Chiu-wai, Gong Li, Faye Wong, Takuya Kimura, Zhang Ziyi, Dong Jie
movies.country: Germany, Hong Kong, China, France, Italy
movies.overview: Women enter and exit a science fiction author's life over the course of a few years after the author loses the woman he considers his one true love.
movies.overview_fa: داستان فیلم از چهار قسمت تشکیل شده است، سه قسمت اول درمورد رابطه «چو» با سه زن است که بعد از از دست دادن عشق زندگی اش، «سو لی ژن» با آن ها آشنا شده. قسمت چهارم در دنیای اسرار آمیز چو، که ۲۰۴۶ نام دارد روی می دهد...
movies.overview_source_for_fa: Women enter and exit a science fiction author's life over the course of a few years after the author loses the woman he considers his one true love.

movies.title: Strangers on a Train
movies.cast: Farley Granger, Ruth Roman, Robert Walker, Leo G. Carroll, Patricia Hitchcock, Kasey Rogers
movies.overview: A charming psychopath tries to coerce a tennis star into his theory that two strangers can commit the perfect crime by exchanging murders—each killing the other’s most-hated person.

movies.title: The X-Files
movies.cast: David Duchovny, Gillian Anderson, Mitch Pileggi, William B. Davis, John Neville, Martin Landau
movies.overview: Mulder and Scully, now taken off the FBI's X Files cases, must find a way to fight the shadowy elements of the government to find out the truth about a conspiracy that might mean the alien colonization of Earth.

movies.title: Dangerous Liaisons
movies.cast: Glenn Close, John Malkovich, Michelle Pfeiffer, Uma Thurman, Swoosie Kurtz, Keanu Reeves
movies.overview: In 18th century France, Marquise de Merteuil asks her ex-lover Vicomte de Valmont to seduce the future wife of another ex-lover of hers in return for one last night with her. Yet things don’t go as planned.
movies.overview_fa: «مارکیز دو مرتوی» (کلوز) و «ویکونت دو و المونت» (مالکوویچ)، اشراف زاده هایی که سابقا دل باخته ی یک دیگر بودند، اینک اوقات شان را صرف نقشه های اغواگرانه و تلافی جویانه می کنند...
movies.overview_source_for_fa: In 18th century France, Marquise de Merteuil asks her ex-lover Vicomte de Valmont to seduce the future wife of another ex-lover of hers in return for one last night with her. Yet things don’t go as planned.

movies.title: Finding Neverland
movies.cast: Johnny Depp, Kate Winslet, Julie Christie, Dustin Hoffman, Freddie Highmore, Radha Mitchell
movies.overview: During a writing slump, playwright J.M. Barrie meets a widow and her four children, all young boys—who soon become an important part of Barrie’s life and the inspiration that lead him to create his masterpiece. Peter Pan.
movies.overview_fa: نمایشنامه نویس موفق اسکاتلندی جی ام باری که یک نابغه، روشنفکر است و تکرار ایده های کلیشه ای او را خسته کرده، و نیاز به الهام دارد.  یک روز، آرزوی او به طور غیرمنتظره ای محقق می شود که در حال قدم زدن در یک پارک در لندن، با خانواده لولین دیویس (چهار پسر و مادر جذاب و بیوه آنها) آشنا می شود. و این انگیزه خلق شاهکار هنری او میشود.
movies.overview_source_for_fa: During a writing slump, playwright J.M. Barrie meets a widow and her four children, all young boys—who soon become an important part of Barrie’s life and the inspiration that lead him to create his masterpiece. Peter Pan.

movies.title: Sliver
movies.cast: Sharon Stone, William Baldwin, Tom Berenger, Polly Walker, Colleen Camp, Amanda Foreman
movies.overview: A woman moves into a Manhattan apartment, where she learns that the previous tenant's life ended under mysterious circumstances.
movies.overview_fa: زن جوانی به نام «کارلی ناریس» (استون) که تازه از همسرش جدا شده، در یکی از مجموعه های مدرن و شیک منهتن به نام «اسلیور» ساکن آپارتمانی می شود که قبلا در اختیار زن جوانی بوده که کشته شده است. «کارلی» با یکی از همسایه ها به نام «هاوکینز» (بالدوین) آشنا می شود. در ساختمان قتل هایی اتفاق می افتد و همسایه ای دیگر به نام «جک» که نویسنده ی داستان های جنایی واقعی است، «کارلی» را متقاعد می کند که «هاوکنیز» قاتل است…
movies.overview_source_for_fa: A woman moves into a Manhattan apartment, where she learns that the previous tenant's life ended under mysterious circumstances.

movies.title: The Color Purple
movies.cast: Danny Glover, Whoopi Goldberg, Margaret Avery, Oprah Winfrey, Willard E. Pugh, Akosua Busia
movies.overview: An epic tale spanning forty years in the life of Celie, an African-American woman living in the South who survives incredible abuse and bigotry. After Celie's abusive father marries her off to the equally debasing 'Mister' Albert Johnson, things go from bad to worse, leaving Celie to find companionship anywhere she can. She perseveres, holding on to her dream of one day being reunited with her sister in Africa.

movies.title: All the President's Men
movies.cast: Dustin Hoffman, Robert Redford, Jack Warden, Martin Balsam, Hal Holbrook, Jason Robards
movies.overview: During the 1972 elections, two reporters' investigation sheds light on the controversial Watergate scandal that compels President Nixon to resign from his post.
movies.overview_fa: ژوئن سال 1972، در ستاد فرماندهی دموکرات ها در دل مجموعه ی واترگیت درواشینگتن، پنج سارق با وسایل مدرن استراق سمع دستگیر می شوند و پی گیری ماجراتوسط دو گزارش گر روزنامه ی واشینگتن پست، «باب وودوارد» (ردفورد) و «کارل برنستاین» (هافمن) پس از چندی منجر به استعفای «رئیس جمهور نیکسن» می شود...
movies.overview_source_for_fa: During the 1972 elections, two reporters' investigation sheds light on the controversial Watergate scandal that compels President Nixon to resign from his post.

movies.title: Cool Hand Luke
movies.cast: Paul Newman, George Kennedy, Luke Askew, Morgan Woodward, Harry Dean Stanton, Dennis Hopper
movies.overview: When petty criminal Luke Jackson is sentenced to two years in a Florida prison farm, he doesn't play by the rules of either the sadistic warden or the yard's resident heavy, Dragline, who ends up admiring the new guy's unbreakable will. Luke's bravado, even in the face of repeated stints in the prison's dreaded solitary confinement cell, "the box," make him a rebel hero to his fellow convicts and a thorn in the side of the prison officers.
movies.overview_fa: از نخستین فیلم های بلند داستانی رزنبرگ، اثری خشن، تلخ، سرد و مؤثر است که با دیگر فیلم های «فرار از زندان» تفاوت هایی اساسی دارد. بی تردید نیومن برای بازی در این نقش شایسته ی دریافت اسکار بود که از او دریغ شد. این فیلم در ایران با نام های «لوک تسلی بخش» و «لوک خونسرد» نیز شناخته می شود. ـ داستان: «لوک جکسن» (نیومن) به جرم شکستن دستگاه های پارکومتر در یکی از شهرهای کوچک جنوب امریکا به دو سال حبس با اعمال شاقه محکوم می شود. او در زندان ابتدا به دلیل خونسردی بیش از حدش مورد نفرت «درگلاین» (کندی)، زندانی گردن کلفت، قرار می گیرد. اما خیلی زود حس احترام «درگلاین» را جلب می کند و با هم اقدام به فرار می کنند...
movies.overview_source_for_fa: When petty criminal Luke Jackson is sentenced to two years in a Florida prison farm, he doesn't play by the rules of either the sadistic warden or the yard's resident heavy, Dragline, who ends up admiring the new guy's unbreakable will. Luke's bravado, even in the face of repeated stints in the prison's dreaded solitary confinement cell, "the box," make him a rebel hero to his fellow convicts and a thorn in the side of the prison officers.

movies.title: Doctor Zhivago
movies.cast: Omar Sharif, Julie Christie, Geraldine Chaplin, Rod Steiger, Alec Guinness, Tom Courtenay
movies.country: Italy, United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: The life of a Russian physician and poet who, although married to another, falls in love with a political activist's wife and experiences hardship during World War I and then the October Revolution.

movies.overview: Senator Walter Chalmers is aiming to take down mob boss Pete Ross with the help of testimony from the criminal's hothead brother Johnny, who is in protective custody in San Francisco under the watch of police lieutenant Frank Bullitt. When a pair of mob hitmen enter the scene, Bullitt follows their trail through a maze of complications and double-crosses. This thriller includes one of the most famous car chases ever filmed.

movies.overview_fa: هالی مارتینز یک رمان نویس داستان های تخیلی است که صاحب منصبی در جنگ وین که توسط متحدان پیروز، به چند بخش تقسیم شده است می شود؛ جایی که کمبود مواد غذایی سبب رونق بازار سیاه شده است. او به دعوت دوست سابق مدرسه ی خود، هری لایم، این کار را می پذیرد اما چندی بعد می فهمد که دوستش در یک حادثه ی عجیب کشته شده است. پس از صحبت با دوستان و همکاران لایم متوجه وجود تضادهایی در حرف های آنان شده و مصمم می شود که کشف کند واقعا چه اتفاقی برای لایم افتاده است.

However, greedy park owner Dial soon catches wind of the duo and makes plans to profit from them.

Dr. Larch imparts his full medical knowledge on Homer, who becomes a skilled, albeit unlicensed, physician. But Homer yearns for a self-chosen life outside the orphanage. What will Homer learn about life and love in the cider house? What of the destiny that Dr. Larch has planned for him?

movies.title: West Side Story
movies.cast: Natalie Wood, Richard Beymer, Russ Tamblyn, Rita Moreno, George Chakiris, Simon Oakland
movies.overview: In Manhattan’s Upper West Side, rival gangs of Polish-Americans and newly arrived Puerto Ricans clash for control of the neighborhood, even as two young members from opposite sides fall dangerously in love.

movies.overview_source_for_fa: In Manhattan’s Upper West Side, rival gangs of Polish-Americans and newly arrived Puerto Ricans clash for control of the neighborhood, even as two young members from opposite sides fall dangerously in love.

movies.overview: Lincoln Hawk a hard-luck big-rig trucker takes us under the glaring Las Vegas lights for all the boisterous action of the World Armwrestling Championship. Relying on wits and willpower, Hawk tries to rebuild his life by capturing the first-place prize money, and the love of the son he abandoned years earlier into the keeping of his rich, ruthless father-in-law.

movies.title: The Transformers: The Movie
movies.cast: Judd Nelson, Peter Cullen, Frank Welker, Leonard Nimoy, Orson Welles, Casey Kasem
movies.overview: The Autobots must stop a colossal planet-consuming robot who goes after the Autobot Matrix of Leadership. At the same time, they must defend themselves against an all-out attack from the Decepticons.

movies.title: Malcolm X
movies.cast: Denzel Washington, Angela Bassett, Albert Hall, Al Freeman Jr., Delroy Lindo, Spike Lee
movies.country: United States of America, Netherlands Antilles
movies.overview: A tribute to the controversial black activist and leader of the struggle for black liberation. He hit bottom during his imprisonment in the '50s, he became a Black Muslim and then a leader in the Nation of Islam. His assassination in 1965 left a legacy of self-determination and racial pride.

movies.title: Traffic
movies.cast: Michael Douglas, Benicio del Toro, Catherine Zeta-Jones, Erika Christensen, Don Cheadle, Jacob Vargas
movies.overview: An exploration of the United States of America's war on drugs from multiple perspectives. For the new head of the Office of National Drug Control Policy, the war becomes personal when he discovers his well-educated daughter is abusing cocaine within their comfortable suburban home. In Mexico, a flawed, but noble policeman agrees to testify against a powerful general in league with a cartel, and in San Diego, a drug kingpin's sheltered trophy wife must learn her husband's ruthless business after he is arrested, endangering her luxurious lifestyle.

movies.title: eXistenZ
movies.cast: Jennifer Jason Leigh, Jude Law, Ian Holm, Willem Dafoe, Don McKellar, Callum Keith Rennie
movies.overview: A game designer on the run from assassins must play her latest virtual reality creation with a marketing trainee to determine if the game has been damaged.

movies.title: My Blueberry Nights
movies.cast: Norah Jones, Jude Law, David Strathairn, Rachel Weisz, Natalie Portman, Cat Power
movies.overview: Elizabeth has just been through a particularly nasty breakup, and now she's ready to leave her friends and memories behind as she chases her dreams across the country. In order to support herself on her journey, Elizabeth picks up a series of waitress jobs along the way. As Elizabeth crosses paths with a series of lost souls whose yearnings are even greater than her own, their emotional turmoil ultimately helps her gain a greater understanding of her own problems...

movies.title: Mr. Deeds
movies.cast: Adam Sandler, Winona Ryder, John Turturro, Allen Covert, Peter Gallagher, Jared Harris
movies.overview: When Longfellow Deeds, a small-town pizzeria owner and poet, inherits $40 billion from his deceased uncle, he quickly begins rolling in a different kind of dough. Moving to the big city, Deeds finds himself besieged by opportunists all gunning for their piece of the pie. Babe, a television tabloid reporter, poses as an innocent small-town girl to do an exposé on Deeds.

movies.title: Moonstruck
movies.cast: Cher, Nicolas Cage, Vincent Gardenia, Olympia Dukakis, Danny Aiello, Julie Bovasso
movies.overview: 37-year-old Italian-American widow Loretta Castorini believes she is unlucky in love, and so accepts a marriage proposal from her boyfriend Johnny, even though she doesn't love him. When she meets his estranged younger brother Ronny, an emotional and passionate man, she finds herself drawn to him. She tries to resist, but Ronny, who blames his brother for the loss of his hand, has no scruples about aggressively pursuing her while Johnny is out of the country. As Loretta falls for Ronny, she learns that she's not the only one in her family with a secret romance.

movies.title: The Lake House
movies.cast: Keanu Reeves, Sandra Bullock, Christopher Plummer, Ebon Moss-Bachrach, Willeke van Ammelrooy, Dylan Walsh
movies.overview: When architect Alex Wyler moves into an unusual glass house on stilts over a lake, he discovers a note from the previous tenant in the mailbox--but no one's lived in the house for years. He replies and soon discovers that he's corresponding with a doctor named Kate Forster. Their correspondence, only through the 'magical' mailbox, turns romantic and their paths cross in unexpected ways, but when they try to truly connect, danger looms. They must try to unravel the mystery behind their extraordinary romance before it's too late.

movies.title: The Last Castle
movies.cast: Robert Redford, James Gandolfini, Mark Ruffalo, Delroy Lindo, Clifton Collins Jr., Kristen Shaw
movies.overview: A court-martialed general rallies together 1200 inmates to rise against the system that put him away.

movies.title: Wasabi
movies.cast: Jean Reno, Ryoko Hirosue, Michel Muller, Carole Bouquet, Yoshi Oida, Christian Sinniger
movies.overview: Hubert is a French policeman with very sharp methods. After being forced to take 2 months off by his boss, who doesn't share his view on working methods, he goes back to Japan, where he used to work 19 years ago, to settle the probate of his girlfriend who left him shortly after marriage without a trace.

movies.title: Payback
movies.cast: Mel Gibson, Gregg Henry, Maria Bello, David Paymer, Bill Duke, Deborah Kara Unger
movies.overview: With friends like these, who needs enemies? That's the question bad guy Porter is left asking after his wife and partner steal his heist money and leave him for dead -- or so they think. Five months and an endless reservoir of bitterness later, Porter's partners and the crooked cops on his tail learn how bad payback can be.

movies.overview: Talented but unproven stock car driver Cole Trickle gets a break and with the guidance of veteran Harry Hogge turns heads on the track. The young hotshot develops a rivalry with a fellow racer that threatens his career when the two smash their cars. But with the help of his doctor, Cole just might overcome his injuries-- and his fear.

movies.title: The Perfect Storm
movies.cast: George Clooney, Mark Wahlberg, Diane Lane, John C. Reilly, William Fichtner, Mary Elizabeth Mastrantonio
movies.overview: In October 1991, a confluence of weather conditions combined to form a killer storm in the North Atlantic. Caught in the storm was the sword-fishing boat Andrea Gail.

movies.title: Kiss of the Dragon
movies.cast: Jet Li, Bridget Fonda, Tchéky Karyo, Ric Young, Burt Kwouk, Laurence Ashley
movies.overview: Liu Jian, an elite Chinese police officer, comes to Paris to arrest a Chinese drug lord. When Jian is betrayed by a French officer and framed for murder, he must go into hiding and find new allies.

movies.overview: Freddy Heflin is the sheriff of a place everyone calls “Cop Land” — a small and seemingly peaceful town populated by the big city police officers he’s long admired. Yet something ugly is taking place behind the town’s peaceful facade. And when Freddy uncovers a massive, deadly conspiracy among these local residents, he is forced to take action and make a dangerous choice between protecting his idols and upholding the law.

movies.title: Lost in Space
movies.cast: William Hurt, Matt LeBlanc, Mimi Rogers, Heather Graham, Gary Oldman, Lacey Chabert
movies.overview: The prospects for continuing life on Earth in the year 2058 are grim. So the Robinsons are launched into space to colonize Alpha Prime, the only other inhabitable planet in the galaxy. But when a stowaway sabotages the mission, the Robinsons find themselves hurtling through uncharted space.

movies.title: Breakdown

movies.overview: On their cross-country drive, a married couple, Jeff and Amy Taylor, experience car trouble after their SUV breaks down. Stranded in the New Mexico desert, the two catch a break when a passing truck driver offers Amy a ride to a nearby café to call for help. Meanwhile, Jeff is able to fix the car and make his way to the café, but Amy isn't there. He tracks down the trucker ― who tells the police he's never seen Jeff or his wife before. Jeff then begins a desperate, frenzied search for Amy.

movies.title: Tenacious D in The Pick of Destiny

movies.overview: In Venice Beach, naive Midwesterner JB bonds with local slacker KG and they form the rock band Tenacious D. Setting out to become the world's greatest band is no easy feat, so they set out to steal what could be the answer to their prayers... a magical guitar pick housed in a rock-and-roll museum some 300 miles away.

movies.title: Bicentennial Man
movies.cast: Robin Williams, Embeth Davidtz, Sam Neill, Oliver Platt, Kiersten Warren, Wendy Crewson
movies.overview: Richard Martin buys a gift, a new NDR-114 robot. The product is named Andrew by the youngest of the family's children. "Bicentennial Man" follows the life and times of Andrew, a robot purchased as a household appliance programmed to perform menial tasks. As Andrew begins to experience emotions and creative thought, the Martin family soon discovers they don't have an ordinary robot.

movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: The relationships of two couples become complicated and deceitful when the man from one couple meets the woman of the other.

Inman deserts his unit and travels across the South, aiming to return to his young wife, Ada, who he left behind to tend their farm. As Inman makes his perilous journey home, Ada struggles to keep their home intact with the assistance of Ruby, a mysterious drifter sent to help her by a kindly neighbor.

movies.title: Jacob's Ladder
movies.cast: Tim Robbins, Elizabeth Peña, Danny Aiello, Matt Craven, Pruitt Taylor Vince, Jason Alexander
movies.overview: After returning home from the Vietnam War, veteran Jacob Singer struggles to maintain his sanity. Plagued by hallucinations and flashbacks, Singer rapidly falls apart as the world and people around him morph and twist into disturbing images. His girlfriend, Jezzie, and ex-wife, Sarah, try to help, but to little avail. Even Singer's chiropractor friend, Louis, fails to reach him as he descends into madness.

movies.overview: In Marseilles a skilled pizza delivery boy Daniel who drives a scooter finally has his dreams come true. He gets a taxi license. Caught by the police for a huge speed infraction, he will help Emilien, a loser inspector who can't drive, on the track of German bank robbers, so he doesn't lose his license and his dream job.

movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America, Hungary
movies.overview: In his homeland of Alagaesia, a farm boy happens upon a dragon's egg -- a discovery that leads him on a predestined journey where he realized he's the one person who can defend his home against an evil king.

movies.overview: A successful businessman falls in love with the girl of his dreams. There's one big complication though; he's fallen hook, line and sinker for a mermaid.

movies.overview: Zack Mayo is an aloof, taciturn man who aspires to be a navy pilot. Once he arrives at training camp for his 13-week officer's course, Mayo runs afoul of abrasive, no-nonsense drill Sergeant Emil Foley. Mayo is an excellent cadet, but a little cold around the heart, so Foley rides him mercilessly, sensing that the young man would be prime officer material if he weren't so self-involved. Zack's affair with a working girl is likewise compromised by his unwillingness to give of himself.

When Ned Trent, embittered ex-partner of Quick's, is assigned to protect one of Quick's potential victims, a deadly game of cat and mouse ensues.

In the castle he finds a funny hunchback, a pretty lab assistant and the elderly housekeeper. Young Frankenstein believes that the work of his grandfather was delusional, but when he discovers the book where the mad doctor described his reanimation experiment, he suddenly changes his mind.

movies.overview: Obsessed scientist Dr. Henry Frankenstein attempts to create life by assembling a creature from deceased body parts. Aided by his loyal misshapen assistant, Fritz, Frankenstein succeeds in animating his monster, but it flees into the countryside and begins to wreak havoc.

movies.overview: A successful physician and devoted family man, John Dolittle seems to have the world by the tail, until a long suppressed talent he possessed as a child, the ability to communicate with animals is suddenly reawakened with a vengeance! Now every creature within squawking distance wants the good doctor's advice, unleashing an outrageous chain of events that turns his world upside down!
