movies.overview: A demonic force has chosen Freddy Krueger as its portal to the real world. Can Heather Langenkamp play the part of Nancy one last time and trap the evil trying to enter our world?

movies.title: Blast from the Past
movies.cast: Brendan Fraser, Alicia Silverstone, Christopher Walken, Sissy Spacek, Dave Foley, Joey Slotnick
movies.overview: Following a bomb scare in the 1960s that locked the Webbers into their bomb shelter for 35 years, Adam now ventures forth into Los Angeles to obtain food and supplies for his family, and a non-mutant wife for himself.

movies.title: Masters of the Universe
movies.cast: Dolph Lundgren, Frank Langella, Billy Barty, Jon Cypher, Courteney Cox, James Tolkan
movies.overview: When He-Man is driven from Eternia after Skeletor seizes Castle Grayskull, a stolen portal device strands the fight on Earth, where a pair of teenagers become entangled in a war that spans worlds.

movies.title: Halloween H20: 20 Years Later
movies.cast: Jamie Lee Curtis, Josh Hartnett, Adam Arkin, Michelle Williams, Adam Hann-Byrd, Jodi Lyn O'Keefe
movies.overview: Two decades after surviving a massacre on October 31, 1978, former baby sitter Laurie Strode finds herself hunted by persistent knife-wielder Michael Myers. Laurie now lives in Northern California under an assumed name, where she works as the headmistress of a private school. But it's not far enough to escape Myers, who soon discovers her whereabouts. As Halloween descends upon Laurie's peaceful community, a feeling of dread weighs upon her -- with good reason.

movies.title: Land of the Dead
movies.cast: Simon Baker, John Leguizamo, Dennis Hopper, Asia Argento, Robert Joy, Eugene Clark
movies.country: Canada, United States of America, France
movies.overview: The living dead have taken over the world, and the remaining humans live in a walled city to protect themselves as they cope with the situation.

movies.title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
movies.original_title: The Man Who Shot Liberty Valance
movies.fa_title: مردی که لیبرتی والانس را کشت
movies.cast: John Wayne, James Stewart, Vera Miles, Lee Marvin, Edmond O'Brien, Andy Devine
movies.overview: Questions arise when Senator Stoddard attends the funeral of a local man named Tom Doniphon in a small Western town. Flashing back, we learn Doniphon saved Stoddard, then a lawyer, when he was roughed up by a crew of outlaws terrorizing the town, led by Liberty Valance. As the territory's safety hung in the balance, Doniphon and Stoddard, two of the only people standing up to him, proved to be very important, but different, foes to Valance.

movies.cast: Chris Sarandon, William Ragsdale, Amanda Bearse, Roddy McDowall, Stephen Geoffreys, Jonathan Stark
movies.overview: Charley Brewster, a high school student, accidentally discovers the true and creepy nature of Jerry Dandrige, his dashing and enigmatic new neighbor; but no one seems willing to believe him.

movies.title: Weird Science
movies.cast: Anthony Michael Hall, Ilan Mitchell-Smith, Kelly LeBrock, Bill Paxton, Suzanne Snyder, Judie Aronson
movies.overview: Two unpopular teenagers, Gary and Wyatt, fail at all attempts to be accepted by their peers. Their desperation to be liked leads them to "create" a woman via their computer. Their living and breathing creation is a gorgeous woman, Lisa, whose purpose is to boost their confidence level by putting them into situations which require Gary and Wyatt to act like men.

movies.title: Father of the Bride
movies.cast: Steve Martin, Diane Keaton, Kimberly Williams-Paisley, Kieran Culkin, George Newbern, Martin Short
movies.overview: George Banks is an ordinary, middle-class man whose 22 year-old daughter Annie has decided to marry a man from an upper-class family, but George can't think of what life would be like without his daughter. His wife tries to make him happy for Annie, but when the wedding takes place at their home and a foreign wedding planner takes over the ceremony, he becomes slightly insane.

movies.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
movies.cast: Donald Sutherland, Brooke Adams, Leonard Nimoy, Jeff Goldblum, Veronica Cartwright, Art Hindle
movies.overview: The residents of San Francisco are becoming drone-like shadows of their former selves, and as the phenomenon spreads, two Department of Health workers uncover the horrifying truth.

movies.cast: Jessica Harper, Stefania Casini, Flavio Bucci, Miguel Bosé, Barbara Magnolfi, Susanna Javicoli
movies.overview: An American newcomer to a prestigious German ballet academy comes to realize that the school is a front for something sinister amid a series of grisly murders.

movies.title: Merry Christmas, Mr. Lawrence
movies.original_title: 戦場のメリークリスマス

movies.overview: Island of Java, 1942, during World War II. British Major Jack Celliers arrives at a Japanese prison camp, run by the strict Captain Yonoi. Colonel John Lawrence, who has a profound knowledge of Japanese culture, and Sergeant Hara, brutal and simpleton, will witness the struggle of wills between two men from very different backgrounds who are tragically destined to clash.

movies.title: Lifeforce
movies.cast: Steve Railsback, Peter Firth, Frank Finlay, Mathilda May, Patrick Stewart, Michael Gothard
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: A race of space vampires arrives in London and infects the populace, commencing an apocalyptic descent into chaos.

movies.title: Young Guns
movies.cast: Emilio Estevez, Kiefer Sutherland, Lou Diamond Phillips, Charlie Sheen, Dermot Mulroney, Casey Siemaszko
movies.overview: A group of young gunmen, led by Billy the Kid, become deputies to avenge the murder of the rancher who became their benefactor. But when Billy takes their authority too far, they become the hunted.

movies.title: Into the Blue
movies.cast: Paul Walker, Jessica Alba, Scott Caan, Ashley Scott, Josh Brolin, James Frain
movies.overview: When they take some friends on an extreme sport adventure, the last thing Jared and Sam expect to see below the shark-infested waters is a legendary pirate ship rumored to contain millions of dollars in gold. But their good fortune is short-lived, as a ruthless gang of criminals gets word of what they have uncovered.

movies.title: Men of Honor
movies.cast: Robert De Niro, Cuba Gooding Jr., Charlize Theron, Aunjanue Ellis-Taylor, Hal Holbrook, Michael Rapaport
movies.overview: Against formidable odds -- and an old-school diving instructor embittered by the U.S. Navy's new, less prejudicial policies -- Carl Brashear sets his sights on becoming the Navy's first African-American master diver in this uplifting true story. Their relationship starts out on the rocks, but fate ultimately conspires to bring the men together into a setting of mutual respect, triumph and honor.

movies.title: Queen of the Damned
movies.cast: Aaliyah, Stuart Townsend, Marguerite Moreau, Vincent Perez, Paul McGann, Lena Olin
movies.overview: Vampire Lestat awakens from his slumber and becomes a rock star. But chaos strikes when his music awakens Akasha, the vampire queen, who may not rest until she makes Lestat her new king.

movies.cast: Nicolas Cage, Adam Beach, Peter Stormare, Noah Emmerich, Mark Ruffalo, Brian Van Holt
movies.country: United States of America, Hong Kong
movies.overview: Joe Enders is a gung-ho Marine assigned to protect a "windtalker" - one of several Navajo Indians who were used to relay messages during World War II because their spoken language was indecipherable to Japanese code breakers.

movies.title: Kramer vs. Kramer
movies.cast: Dustin Hoffman, Meryl Streep, Jane Alexander, Justin Henry, Howard Duff, George Coe
movies.overview: Ted Kramer is a career man for whom his work comes before his family. His wife Joanna cannot take this anymore, so she decides to leave him. Ted is now faced with the tasks of housekeeping and taking care of himself and their young son Billy.

movies.overview: When police funding is cut, the Governor announces he must close one of the academies. To make it fair, the two police academies must compete against each other to stay in operation. Mauser persuades two officers in Lassard's academy to better his odds, but things don't quite turn out as expected...

movies.title: What Dreams May Come
movies.cast: Robin Williams, Cuba Gooding Jr., Annabella Sciorra, Max von Sydow, Jessica Brooks Grant, Josh Paddock
movies.overview: After Chris Nielsen dies in a car accident, he is guided through the afterlife by his spirit guide, Albert. His new world is beautiful and can be whatever Chris imagines. Even his children are there. But, when his wife, Annie, commits suicide and is sent to hell, Chris ignores Albert's warnings and journeys there to save her. Upon arrival, Chris finds that rescuing Annie will be more difficult than he'd imagined.

movies.cast: Mickey Rourke, Marisa Tomei, Evan Rachel Wood, Mark Margolis, Todd Barry, Wass Stevens
movies.overview: Aging wrestler Randy "The Ram" Robinson is long past his prime but still ready and rarin' to go on the pro-wrestling circuit. After a particularly brutal beating, however, Randy hangs up his tights, pursues a serious relationship with a long-in-the-tooth stripper, and tries to reconnect with his estranged daughter. But he can't resist the lure of the ring and readies himself for a comeback.

movies.title: Star Wars: The Clone Wars
movies.cast: Matt Lanter, Ashley Eckstein, James Arnold Taylor, David Acord, Dee Bradley Baker, Christopher Lee
movies.overview: As the Clone Wars sweep through the galaxy, Anakin Skywalker and his new Padawan learner Ahsoka Tano plunge into a dangerous mission to rescue the kidnapped son of crime lord Jabba the Hutt.

movies.cast: Joey Lawrence, Billy Joel, Cheech Marin, Richard Mulligan, Roscoe Lee Browne, Sheryl Lee Ralph
movies.overview: Putting its own 'twist' on the story of Oliver Twist, the orange runt of a litter of kittens must fight for survival on the rough streets on New York City, finding unlikely friends in the dogs owned by a down-on-his luck man named Fagin. Soon, Oliver and his new band of comrades must fight for survival when Fagin is unable to pay his debts.

movies.title: Ghosts of Girlfriends Past
movies.cast: Matthew McConaughey, Jennifer Garner, Michael Douglas, Breckin Meyer, Lacey Chabert, Robert Forster
movies.overview: Celebrity photographer Connor Mead lives life in the fast lane, committed to lifelong bachelorhood and simultaneous relationships with multiple women. On the eve of his younger brother Paul's wedding, Connor's mockery of love proves a real buzz-kill for everyone - including his childhood crush, Jenny, the one woman who always seemed immune to his considerable charms. Later that night, he gets a wake-up call from the ghost of his late Uncle Wayne, the hard-partying, legendary ladies' man who was Connor's mentor. Uncle Wayne has an urgent message which he delivers through three ghosts who guide Connor on an eye-opening tour of his romantic past, present and future. Along the way, they attempt to discern whether he will ever be able to change his ways -- and if there is any hope of him finding true love.

movies.title: Pokémon 4Ever
movies.original_title: 劇場版ポケットモンスター セレビィ 時を超えた遭遇

movies.overview: In order to escape a greedy Pokémon hunter, Celebi must use the last of its energy to travel through time to the present day. Celebi brings along Sammy, a boy who had been trying to protect it. Along with Ash, Pikachu, and the rest of the gang, Sammy and Celebi must encounter an enemy far more advanced than the hunter, with the fate of the forest hanging in the balance.

movies.title: Can't Buy Me Love
movies.cast: Patrick Dempsey, Amanda Peterson, Courtney Gains, Tina Caspary, Seth Green, Sharon Farrell
movies.overview: Nerdy high schooler Ronald Miller rescues cheerleader Cindy Mancini from parental punishment after she accidentally destroys her mother's designer clothes. Ronald agrees to pay for the $1,000 outfit on one condition: that she will act as though they're a couple for an entire month. As the days pass, however, Cindy grows fond of Ronald, making him popular. But when Ronald's former best friend gets left behind, he realizes that social success isn't everything.

movies.title: Barbie in the 12 Dancing Princesses
movies.cast: Kelly Sheridan, Catherine O'Hara, Christopher Gaze, Nicole Oliver, Jennifer Copping, Lalainia Lindbjerg
movies.overview: King Randolph sends for his cousin, Duchess Rowena, to help turn his daughters, Princess Genevieve and her eleven sisters, into royal material. But the Duchess strips the sisters of their fun, including their favorite pastime: dancing. When all hope may be lost, the sisters discover a secret passageway to a magical land where they can dance the night away.

movies.title: Scooby-Doo on Zombie Island
movies.cast: Scott Innes, Billy West, Mary Kay Bergman, Frank Welker, B.J. Ward, Adrienne Barbeau
movies.overview: After going their separate ways, Scooby-Doo, Shaggy, Velma, Daphne, and Fred reunite to investigate the ghost of Moonscar the pirate on a haunted bayou island, but it turns out the swashbuckler's spirit isn't the only creepy character on the island. The sleuths also meet up with cat creatures and zombies... and it looks like for the first time in their lives, these ghouls might actually be real.

movies.title: Big Stan
movies.cast: Rob Schneider, David Carradine, Jennifer Morrison, Scott Wilson, Tsuyoshi Abe, Henry Gibson
movies.overview: A weak con man panics when he learns he's going to prison for fraud. He hires a mysterious martial arts guru who helps transform him into a martial arts expert who can fight off inmates who want to hurt or love him.

movies.title: Moonwalker
movies.director: Colin Chilvers, Will Vinton, Jerry Kramer, Jim Blashfield

movies.cast: Camille Keaton, Eron Tabor, Richard Pace, Anthony Nichols, Gunter Kleemann, Tammy Zarchi
movies.overview: A young, beautiful career woman rents a backwoods cabin to write her first novel. Attacked by a group of local lowlifes and left for dead, she devises a horrific plan to inflict revenge.

movies.title: Tinker Bell and the Lost Treasure
movies.original_title: Tinker Bell and the Lost Treasure
movies.cast: Mae Whitman, Jesse McCartney, Jane Horrocks, Lucy Liu, Raven-Symoné, Kristin Chenoweth
movies.overview: A blue harvest moon will rise, allowing the fairies to use a precious moonstone to restore the Pixie Dust Tree, the source of all their magic. But when Tinker Bell accidentally puts all of Pixie Hollow in jeopardy, she must venture out across the sea on a secret quest to set things right.

movies.title: Rob-B-Hood
movies.cast: Jackie Chan, Louis Koo, Michael Hui Koon-man, Teresa Carpio, Yuen Biao, Gao Yuanyuan
movies.overview: For never-do-well compulsive gambler Fong, there's only one thing more fearsome than debtors at his doorstep - having to coax a crying baby. But what if the baby becomes his golden goose to fend off his debtors? Can he overcome his phobia of diapers, milk bottles, and cloying lullabies?

movies.title: Everybody's Fine
movies.cast: Robert De Niro, Drew Barrymore, Kate Beckinsale, Sam Rockwell, Melissa Leo, Damian Young
movies.overview: Eight months after the death of his wife, Frank Goode looks forward to a reunion with his four adult children. When all of them cancel their visits at the last minute, Frank, against the advice of his doctor, sets out on a road trip to reconnect with his offspring. As he visits each one in turn, Frank finds that his children's lives are not quite as picture-perfect as they've made them out to be.

movies.title: Buried
movies.cast: Ryan Reynolds, José Luis García Pérez, Robert Paterson, Stephen Tobolowsky, Samantha Mathis, Ivana Miño
movies.country: Spain, United States of America, France, United Kingdom
movies.overview: As an American civilian truck driver working in Iraq, Paul Conroy's convoy is attacked by a group of Iraqi insurgents. Some time later, Paul awakes in a coffin with only a lighter, a cell phone, and his ever-growing anxiety. Faced with a dwindling oxygen supply and a dying battery, he must fight panic, despair, and delirium as he races against time to escape the claustrophobic death trap.

movies.title: Naked Killer
movies.cast: Chingmy Yau Suk-Ching, Simon Yam, Carrie Ng Ka-lai, Yiu Wai, Benz Hui Siu-hung, Madoka Sugawara
movies.overview: A young woman is trained by a professional assassin to become her partner in crime.

movies.title: Pulse
movies.cast: Haruhiko Kato, Kumiko Aso, Koyuki, Kurume Arisaka, Masatoshi Matsuo, Shun Sugata
movies.overview: In the immense city of Tokyo, the darkness of the afterlife lures some of its inhabitants desperately trying to escape the sadness and isolation of the modern world.

movies.title: Love Exposure
movies.cast: Takahiro Nishijima, Hikari Mitsushima, Sakura Ando, Makiko Watanabe, Atsuro Watabe, Yutaka Shimizu
movies.overview: The story of a teenage boy called Yu, who falls for Yoko, a girl he runs into while operating for the sake of sin as an upskirt photographer in an offshoot of the porn industry. His attempts to woo her are complicated by a spot of cross-dressing - which convinces Yoko that she is lesbian - dalliances with kung-fu and crime, and a constant struggle with the guilt that's a legacy of his Catholic upbringing.

movies.title: Dragon Ball Z: Dead Zone
movies.original_title: ドラゴンボールＺ オラの悟飯をかえせッ!!
movies.cast: Masako Nozawa, Toshio Furukawa, Hiromi Tsuru, Mayumi Tanaka, Daisuke Gori, Mayumi Shou
movies.overview: In order to wish for immortality and avenge his father, Garlic Jr. collects the dragon balls, kidnapping Goku's son Gohan in the process. Goku, Kami, Piccolo, and Krillin unite to rescue Gohan and save the world from being sucked into a dead zone.

movies.title: Detective Conan: The Raven Chaser
movies.original_title: 名探偵コナン 漆黒の追跡者（チェイサー）
movies.cast: Minami Takayama, Kappei Yamaguchi, Wakana Yamazaki, Akira Kamiya, Megumi Hayashibara, Yukiko Iwai
movies.overview: A new member from the Black Organization that shrunk Shinichi's body manages to find out about Shinichi's transformation into Conan. This discovery starts to put those around him in danger as Gin and the other Black Organization members start to take action.

movies.title: Detective Conan: The Last Wizard of the Century
movies.original_title: 名探偵コナン 世紀末の魔術師
movies.cast: Minami Takayama, Kappei Yamaguchi, Wakana Yamazaki, Akira Kamiya, Chafurin, Kaneto Shiozawa
movies.overview: Kaitou Kid dares to challenge the police once more, setting his sights on the Russian Imperial Easter Egg. With the date, time, and place, the Osaka police force scrambles to stop him. But this time, Kid may have bitten off more than he can chew—Conan Edogawa, Heiji Hattori, and numerous others are also trying to get their hands on the jeweled egg.

movies.title: The Legend of the Nahuala
movies.cast: Fabrizio Santini, Martha Higareda, Andrés Bustamante, Jesús Ochoa, Rafael Inclán, Ofelia Medina
movies.overview: Leo San Juan, an insecure child of nine years old, lives eternally frightened by horror stories that Nando tells his older brother. Within these stories it is 'The Legend of Nahuala', according to which, an old abandoned Casona is possessed by the spirit of an evil witch known as the Nahuala.
movies.overview_fa: لئو سان خوان، یک کودک نه ساله بی‌پناه، در ترس ابدی از داستان‌های ترسناکی که ناندو، برادر بزرگترش، تعریف می‌کند، زندگی می‌کند. در بطن این داستان‌ها «افسانه ناهوالا» است که بر اساس آن، یک خانه بزرگ رها شده قدیمی توسط روح یک جادوگر شیطانی به نام ناهوالا تسخیر شده است.
movies.overview_source_for_fa: Leo San Juan, an insecure child of nine years old, lives eternally frightened by horror stories that Nando tells his older brother. Within these stories it is 'The Legend of Nahuala', according to which, an old abandoned Casona is possessed by the spirit of an evil witch known as the Nahuala.

movies.title: Mother
movies.cast: Kim Hye-ja, Won Bin, Jin Goo, Yoon Je-moon, Jeon Mi-seon, Song Sae-byuk
movies.overview: A mother lives quietly with her son. One day, a girl is brutally killed, and the boy is charged with the murder. Now, it's his mother's mission to prove him innocent.

movies.title: The Deep End of the Ocean
movies.original_title: The Deep End of the Ocean
movies.cast: Michelle Pfeiffer, Treat Williams, Whoopi Goldberg, Jonathan Jackson, Cory Buck, Ryan Merriman
movies.overview: A three-year-old boy disappears during his mother's high school reunion. Nine years later, by chance, he turns up in the town in which the family has just relocated.

movies.title: Lupin the Third: Island of Assassins
movies.cast: Kanichi Kurita, Kiyoshi Kobayashi, Eiko Masuyama, Makio Inoue, Gorō Naya, Emi Shinohara
movies.overview: Lupin is framed for the murder of Inspector Zenigata by a mysterious assailant holding a silver-coloured Walther P38 pistol Lupin himself once owned. Tracking the true killer leads Lupin to the island of the bloodthirsty Tarantula assassins inside the Devil’s Triangle. After joining the spider-tattooed army against their will, Lupin and his gang make both new friends and enemies as they not only plan to take home the Tarantulas’ massive gold repository for themselves, but hunt down the shooter from Lupin’s past. Can Lupin put to rest this demon who haunts his memories with the Walther P38?

movies.title: Valentine's Day
movies.cast: Jessica Alba, Kathy Bates, Jessica Biel, Bradley Cooper, Eric Dane, Patrick Dempsey
movies.overview: Intertwining couples and singles in Los Angeles break-up and make-up based on the pressures and expectations of Valentine's Day.

movies.title: Pokémon Heroes
movies.original_title: 劇場版ポケットモンスター 水の都の護神 ラティアスとラティオス
movies.cast: Rica Matsumoto, Ikue Otani, Mayumi Izuka, Yuji Ueda, Satomi Korogi, Megumi Hayashibara
movies.overview: Ash, Pikachu and the gang try and stop a pair of thieves hiding out in the canals and alleyways of Altomare, the age-old water capital. Joining the adventure are two new legendary Pokémon, a pair of siblings named Latias and Latios, who serve as peacekeepers and protectors of the Soul Dew — a priceless treasure with a mysterious power.

movies.title: Wall Street: Money Never Sleeps
movies.fa_title: وال استریت: پول هرگز نمی میرد
movies.cast: Michael Douglas, Shia LaBeouf, Josh Brolin, Carey Mulligan, Frank Langella, Susan Sarandon
movies.overview: As the global economy teeters on the brink of disaster, a young Wall Street trader partners with disgraced former Wall Street corporate raider Gordon Gekko on a two tiered mission: To alert the financial community to the coming doom, and to find out who was responsible for the death of the young trader's mentor.
movies.overview_fa: در حالی‌که اقتصاد جهانی در آستانه فاجعه‌ای بی‌سابقه قرار دارد، کارگزار جوانی از وال استریت با گوردن جکوِ کهنه‌کار اما بدنام همکار می‌شود تا ماموریت دوجانبه‌ای را به سرانجام برسانند. آن‌ها از یک سو می‌خواهند جامعه مالی را از سرنوشت شومی که در راه است مطلع سازند و از سوی دیگر به هویت کسی پی‌ببرند که مسئول مرگ پیش‌کسوتِ سابقِ کارگزار جوان بوده است.
movies.overview_source_for_fa: As the global economy teeters on the brink of disaster, a young Wall Street trader partners with disgraced former Wall Street corporate raider Gordon Gekko on a two tiered mission: To alert the financial community to the coming doom, and to find out who was responsible for the death of the young trader's mentor.

movies.title: She's Out of My League
movies.cast: Jay Baruchel, Alice Eve, T.J. Miller, Nate Torrence, Mike Vogel, Lindsay Sloane
movies.overview: When he starts dating drop-dead gorgeous Molly, insecure airport security agent Kirk can't believe it. As his friends and family share their doubts about the relationship lasting, Kirk does everything he can to avoid losing Molly forever.

movies.title: Judas & Jesus
movies.cast: Friedemann Encke, Olaf Encke, Sandra Pfeiffer, Klaus Hensheid, Die Suurbiers, Peter Kock
movies.overview: Judas is the hero and Jesus is the villain in this lewd retelling of the classic Bible story. Depicted through anthropomorphic animals, we see a unique alternative perspective. Judas (an unscrupulous black goat) has been at odds with Jesus (a self-righteous white sheep) ever since childhood. However, when an opportunity arises to sell Jesus out for the 30 Euros he needs to get into Maria Magdalena's sex show, things finally seem to start going Judas' way. But what will Jesus' adoring fans have to say about it?

movies.title: Date Night
movies.cast: Steve Carell, Tina Fey, Mark Wahlberg, Taraji P. Henson, Jimmi Simpson, Common
movies.overview: Phil and Claire Foster fear that their mild-mannered relationship may be falling into a stale rut. During their weekly date night, their dinner reservation leads to their being mistaken for a couple of thieves—and now a number of unsavoury characters want Phil and Claire killed.

movies.title: Swing Girls
movies.cast: Juri Ueno, Yuta Hiraoka, Shihori Kanjiya, Yuika Motokariya, Yukari Toyoshima, Naoto Takenaka
movies.overview: A group of delinquent high school girls form a band when they accidentally poison their school's brass band and have to replace them.

movies.title: Letters to Juliet
movies.cast: Amanda Seyfried, Christopher Egan, Gael García Bernal, Vanessa Redgrave, Franco Nero, Luisa Ranieri
movies.overview: An American girl on vacation in Italy finds an unanswered "letter to Juliet" -- one of thousands of missives left at the fictional lover's Verona courtyard, which are typically answered by the "secretaries of Juliet" -- and she goes on a quest to find the lovers referenced in the letter.

movies.title: The Firm
movies.cast: Tom Cruise, Jeanne Tripplehorn, Gene Hackman, Hal Holbrook, Terry Kinney, Wilford Brimley
movies.overview: Mitch McDeere is a young man with a promising future in Law. About to sit his Bar exam, he is approached by 'The Firm' and made an offer he doesn't refuse. Seduced by the money and gifts showered on him, he is totally oblivious to the more sinister side of his company. Then, two Associates are murdered. The FBI contact him, asking him for information and suddenly his life is ruined. He has a choice - work with the FBI, or stay with the Firm. Either way he will lose his life as he knows it. Mitch figures the only way out is to follow his own plan...
movies.overview_fa: فیلم درباره فساد و تباهی در یک نهاد تجارتی / اقتصادی / حقوقی و مبارزه ی جوان آرمان گرای تازه فارغ التحصیل آماده ی جهش به طبقه ی بالاتر اجتماعی- با همه ی وجوه تمثیلی آن از کلیت جامعه امریکا در قالب این نهاد کوچک. یک شرکت عظیم تجارتی در ممفیس، «میچ مک دیر» (کروز) را در مقام مشاور حقوقی استخدام می کند. اما او خیلی زود بر سر دو راهی گیر می کند: یا باید با مأموران FBI هم کاری کند یا به دست عوامل مافیا که کنترل شرکت را به دست دارند کشته خواهد شد...
movies.overview_source_for_fa: Mitch McDeere is a young man with a promising future in Law. About to sit his Bar exam, he is approached by 'The Firm' and made an offer he doesn't refuse. Seduced by the money and gifts showered on him, he is totally oblivious to the more sinister side of his company. Then, two Associates are murdered. The FBI contact him, asking him for information and suddenly his life is ruined. He has a choice - work with the FBI, or stay with the Firm. Either way he will lose his life as he knows it. Mitch figures the only way out is to follow his own plan...

movies.title: All Ladies Do It
movies.cast: Claudia Koll, Paolo Lanza, Ornella Marcucci, Isabella Deiana, Franco Branciaroli, Renzo Rinaldi
movies.overview: After five years of marriage, Diana discovers the joys of adultery, claiming that she can save her failing relationship through betrayal.

movies.title: The Tourist
movies.cast: Johnny Depp, Angelina Jolie, Paul Bettany, Timothy Dalton, Steven Berkoff, Rufus Sewell
movies.overview: American tourist Frank meets mysterious British woman Elise on the train to Venice. Romance seems to bud, but there's more to her than meets the eye.
movies.overview_fa: فرانک یک خلافکار و تبهکار آمریکایی است که تحت تعقیب پلیس بیل الملل قرار دارد. او برای در امان ماندن از دستگیری مرتبا تحت اسامی مختلف به کشورهای متفاوتی سفر می کند تا اینکه در سفر آخر خود با زنی به نام الیس آشنا می شود اما او بی خبر از این است که الیس مامور مخفی اینترپل است.
movies.overview_source_for_fa: American tourist Frank meets mysterious British woman Elise on the train to Venice. Romance seems to bud, but there's more to her than meets the eye.

movies.title: Sex and the City 2
movies.cast: Sarah Jessica Parker, Kim Cattrall, Kristin Davis, Cynthia Nixon, Chris Noth, David Eigenberg
movies.overview: Carrie, Charlotte, and Miranda are all married now, but they're still up for a little fun in the sun. When Samantha gets the chance to visit one of the most extravagant vacation destinations on the planet and offers to bring them all along, they surmise that a women-only retreat may be the perfect excuse to eschew their responsibilities and remember what life was like before they decided to settle down.

movies.title: 5 Centimeters per Second
movies.cast: Kenji Mizuhashi, Yoshimi Kondou, Satomi Hanamura, Risa Mizuno, Ayaka Onoue, Yuka Terasaki
movies.overview: Three moments in Takaki's life: his relationship with Akari and their forced separation; his friendship with Kanae, who is secretly in love with him; the demands and disappointments of adulthood, an unhappy life in a cold city.
movies.overview_fa: دو نوجوان به نام‌های تاکاکی و آکاری که در یک کلاس مشغول به تحصیل هستند، با گذشت زمان به دوستان صمیمی یکدیگر تبدیل می‌شوند. این در حالی است که رابطه صمیمانه آنها در مواجهه با چالش‌های مختلف، به طور جدی محک می‌خورد و...
movies.overview_source_for_fa: Three moments in Takaki's life: his relationship with Akari and their forced separation; his friendship with Kanae, who is secretly in love with him; the demands and disappointments of adulthood, an unhappy life in a cold city.

movies.title: Eat Pray Love
movies.cast: Julia Roberts, Javier Bardem, James Franco, Billy Crudup, Richard Jenkins, Viola Davis
movies.overview: A married woman realizes how unhappy her marriage really is, and that her life needs to go in a different direction. After a painful divorce, she takes off on a round-the-world journey to "find herself".

movies.title: Unthinkable
movies.cast: Samuel L. Jackson, Carrie-Anne Moss, Michael Sheen, Stephen Root, Lora Kojovic, Martin Donovan
movies.overview: The government gets wind of a plot to destroy America involving a trio of nuclear weapons for which the whereabouts are unknown. It's up to a seasoned interrogator and an FBI agent to find out exactly where the nukes are.

movies.title: Zookeeper
movies.cast: Kevin James, Rosario Dawson, Leslie Bibb, Joe Rogan, Nat Faxon, Ken Jeong
movies.overview: Kindhearted Griffin Keyes is one of the best-loved caretakers at the Franklin Park Zoo, but he's more comfortable with the animals than with females of his own species as proven by his failed marriage proposal to the self-absorbed Stephanie several years ago. The animals have listened to Griffin pine over her for years and, after she reappears in his life, they decide to help Griffin rekindle the relationship and become the alpha male she wants him to be. They inadvertently reveal their secret ability to talk and, after Griffin's initial shock, teach him the rules of courtship, animal-style. Surprisingly, the animals' advice really works and Griffin is about to get everything he's ever dreamed of--or is he?

movies.title: Priest
movies.cast: Paul Bettany, Karl Urban, Lily Collins, Maggie Q, Stephen Moyer, Cam Gigandet
movies.overview: In an alternate world, humanity and vampires have warred for centuries. After the last Vampire War, the veteran Warrior Priest lives in obscurity with other humans inside one of the Church's walled cities. When the Priest's niece is kidnapped by vampires, the Priest breaks his vows to hunt them down. He is accompanied by the niece's boyfriend, who is a wasteland sheriff, and a former Warrior Priestess.

movies.title: Life As We Know It
movies.cast: Katherine Heigl, Josh Duhamel, Josh Lucas, Alexis Clagett, Brynn Clagett, Brooke Clagett
movies.overview: After a disastrous first date for caterer Holly and network sports director Messer, all they have in common is a dislike for each other and their love for their goddaughter Sophie. But when they suddenly become all Sophie has in this world, Holly and Messer must set their differences aside. Juggling careers and social calendars, they'll have to find common ground while living under the same roof.

movies.title: Winter's Bone
movies.cast: Jennifer Lawrence, John Hawkes, Kevin Breznahan, Dale Dickey, Garret Dillahunt, Sheryl Lee
movies.overview: After discovering her father put their house up for his bail bond and then disappeared, 17-year-old Ree Dolly must confront the local criminal underworld and the harsh Ozark wilderness in order to to track down her father and save her family.

movies.title: Dragon Ball Z: Super Android 13!
movies.original_title: ドラゴンボールＺ 極限バトル！三大超サイヤ人
movies.cast: Masako Nozawa, Ryo Horikawa, Takeshi Kusao, Toshio Furukawa, Mayumi Tanaka, Kohei Miyauchi
movies.overview: Dr. Gero's Androids #13, #14, and #15 are awakened by the laboratory computers and immediately head to the mall where Goku is shopping. After Goku, Trunks, and Vegeta defeat #14 and #15, #13 absorbs their inner computers and becomes a super being greater than the original three separately were. Now it is up to Goku to stop him.

movies.title: Dragon Ball Z: Bojack Unbound
movies.original_title: ドラゴンボールZ 銀河ギリギリ!! ぶっちぎりの凄い奴
movies.cast: Masako Nozawa, Daisuke Gori, Tessyo Genda, Toshio Furukawa, Mayumi Tanaka, Takeshi Kusao
movies.overview: Mr. Money is holding another World Martial Arts Tournament and Mr. Satan invites everyone in the world to join in. Little does he know that Bojack, an ancient villain who has escaped his prison, is competing. Since Goku is currently dead, it is up to Gohan, Vegeta, and Trunks to defeat Bojack and his henchman.

movies.title: Dragon Ball Z: Fusion Reborn
movies.original_title: ドラゴンボールZ 復活のフュージョン!! 悟空とベジータ
movies.cast: Masako Nozawa, Ryo Horikawa, Takeshi Kusao, Daisuke Gori, Hiromi Tsuru, Naoko Watanabe
movies.overview: Not paying attention to his job, a young demon allows the evil cleansing machine to overflow and explode, turning the young demon into the infamous monster Janemba. Goku and Vegeta make solo attempts to defeat the monster, but realize their only option is fusion.

movies.title: Dragon Ball: Curse of the Blood Rubies
movies.original_title: ドラゴンボール 神龍の伝説
movies.cast: Masako Nozawa, Hiromi Tsuru, Naoki Tatsuta, Naoko Watanabe, Toru Furuya, Kohei Miyauchi
movies.overview: The great King Gurumes is searching for the Dragon Balls in order to put a stop to his endless hunger. A young girl named Pansy who lives in the nearby village has had enough of the treachery and decides to seek Muten Rōshi for assistance. Can our heroes save the village and put a stop to the Gurumes Army?

movies.title: Vampires Suck
movies.cast: Jenn Proske, Matt Lanter, Chris Riggi, Diedrich Bader, Anneliese Van Der Pol, Ken Jeong
movies.overview: Becca, an anxious, non-vampire teen is torn between two boys. Before she can choose, Becca must get around her controlling father, who treats her like a child. Meanwhile, Becca's friends contend with their own romantic issues – all of which collide at the prom.

movies.title: Salon Kitty
movies.cast: Helmut Berger, Ingrid Thulin, Teresa Ann Savoy, John Steiner, Sara Sperati, Maria Michi
movies.overview: Set in Berlin at the dawn of World War II, Salon Kitty follows an ambitious SS officer who takes control of a premier, high-end brothel frequented by foreign diplomats and Nazi elites. Replacing the original workers with fanatical German women trained as informants, he covertly transforms the luxury establishment into a sophisticated intelligence hub to gather secret information from its powerful clientele.

movies.title: Batman: Under the Red Hood
movies.cast: Bruce Greenwood, Jensen Ackles, Neil Patrick Harris, Jason Isaacs, John DiMaggio, Wade Williams
movies.overview: One part vigilante, one part criminal kingpin, Red Hood begins cleaning up Gotham with the efficiency of Batman, but without following the same ethical code.

movies.cast: Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Seth Rogen, Anna Kendrick, Bryce Dallas Howard, Anjelica Huston, Serge Houde
movies.overview: Inspired by a true story, a comedy centered on a 27-year-old guy who learns of his cancer diagnosis and his subsequent struggle to beat the disease.

movies.title: Faster
movies.cast: Dwayne Johnson, Billy Bob Thornton, Oliver Jackson-Cohen, Maggie Grace, Carla Gugino, Tom Berenger
movies.overview: After 10 years in prison, Driver is now a free man with a single focus - hunting down the people responsible for brutally murdering his brother.

movies.title: Due Date
movies.cast: Robert Downey Jr., Zach Galifianakis, Michelle Monaghan, Jamie Foxx, Juliette Lewis, Danny McBride
movies.overview: Peter Highman must scramble across the US in five days to be present for the birth of his first child. He gets off to a bad start when his wallet and luggage are stolen, and put on the 'no-fly' list. Peter embarks on a terrifying journey when he accepts a ride from an actor.

movies.title: Never Let Me Go
movies.cast: Carey Mulligan, Keira Knightley, Andrew Garfield, Izzy Meikle-Small, Ella Purnell, Charlie Rowe
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: As children, Kathy, Ruth, and Tommy spend their childhood at an idyllic and secluded English boarding school. As they grow into adults, they must come to terms with the complexity and strength of their love for one another while also preparing for the haunting reality awaiting them.
movies.overview_fa: کتی، تامی و روث سه کودک یتیم هستند که در مدرسه ی شبانه روزی با یکدیگر آشنا و رابطه دوستی بین آنها برقرا شده است. زمانی که آن‌ها بالغ می شوند، با وجود عشق عمیقی که میان آن‌هاست، باید با حقیقت تلخی که از کودکی انتظارشان را می کشیده است، روبرو شوند.
movies.overview_source_for_fa: As children, Kathy, Ruth, and Tommy spend their childhood at an idyllic and secluded English boarding school. As they grow into adults, they must come to terms with the complexity and strength of their love for one another while also preparing for the haunting reality awaiting them.

movies.title: Burlesque
movies.cast: Cher, Christina Aguilera, Cam Gigandet, Kristen Bell, Stanley Tucci, Eric Dane
movies.overview: Ali leaves behind a troubled life and follows her dreams to Los Angeles, where she lands a job as a cocktail waitress at the Burlesque Lounge, a once-majestic theater that houses an inspired musical revue. Vowing to perform there, she makes the leap from bar to stage, helping restore the club's former glory.

movies.title: Memories
movies.director: Katsuhiro Otomo, Koji Morimoto, Tensai Okamura

When Katie Kim mistakenly finds herself with the winning ticket, she reluctantly joins forces with amateur lottery protection agent Noel Cassidy who must get her to sundown in exchange for a piece of her prize.
movies.overview_fa: در آینده نزدیک، یک "بخت‌آزمایی بزرگ" ایجاد شده است - نکته جالب ماجرا اینه که: برنده را قبل از غروب آفتاب بکشید تا به‌طور قانونی جایزه بزرگ چند میلیارد دلاری او را از آن خود کنید. هنگامی که کیتی کیم به‌اشتباه خود را با بلیط برنده می‌یابد، با اکراه با مامور محافظت از قرعه‌کشی تازه‌کار نوئل کسیدی که باید او را به غروب آفتاب در ازای بخشی از جایزه‌اش برساند، می‌پیوندد.

movies.overview: A young couple, Wan-jin and So-hee, are living with Wan-jin's single father, Seok-bong. Seok-bong was preying on his daughter-in-law, who was doing the housework and preparing meals for him while her husband was away at work. He pretended to have dementia and attacked her. So-hee, who was suffering from her shame, suggested to Wan-jin to hire his father a caregiver, saying that his father seemed to be suffering from dementia, and so Bok-ja, a sexy and voluptuous caregiver who was about Seok-bong's age, came in. Seok-bong is captivated by Bok-ja's passionate charm and soon begins to share his love with her, and in this way, she takes the place of Wan-jin's new mother.

movies.overview: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

Over the ensuing decades, the destiny of the two young disciples entwines and twists – and only one will become the greatest Japanese master of Kabuki.

movies.title: Is God Is

movies.overview: Two sisters embark on an epic quest for revenge, confronting a charged family history that pushes them to extraordinary lengths.

movies.title: The Eyes

Now trapped in encroaching darkness, Seo-jin faces a terrifying revelation that shatters everything she thought she knew.

movies.title: Popeye the Slayer Man

movies.title: Laila
movies.cast: Vishwak Sen, Akanksha Sharma, Babloo Prithiveeraj, Abhimanyu Singh, Vineet Kumar, Kamakshi Bhaskarla

movies.title: Squid Game: Making Season 2
movies.cast: Hwang Dong-hyuk, Lee Jung-jae, Lee Byung-hun, Chae Kyoung-sun, Kim Ji-yong, Gong Yoo
movies.overview: From set designs to character arcs, get exclusive cast and director interviews on how Season 2 of the globally most-watched series was brought to life.

movies.title: Ikatan Darah
movies.cast: Livi Ciananta, Derby Romero, Ismi Melinda, Lydia Kandou, Teuku Rifnu Wikana, Abdurrahman Arif
movies.overview: A former martial arts athlete must face a network of loan sharks to save her younger brother, who is trapped in online gambling debt and risking their family’s safety.

movies.title: 40 Dates and 40 Nights
movies.cast: Bailee Madison, Joel Courtney, Jack Schumacher, Luxy Banner, Eric Nelsen, Liz Mikel
movies.overview: Ready to quit the dating scene altogether, burned-out Leah accepts her grandmother's outrageous challenge—40 dates in 40 nights in exchange for a year's rent—only to discover amidst the awkward dinners and unexpected sparks that her biggest obstacle to love is herself.

movies.title: Bury the Devil
movies.cast: Emmanuelle Lussier Martinez, Bill Rowat, Mark Antony Krupa, Dawn Ford
movies.overview: When a hospice nurse finds herself trapped with a dementia patient, she begins to suspect something else is wrong with the woman, something otherworldly, and must fight to survive the night.

movies.title: Muzzle: City of Wolves
movies.cast: Aaron Eckhart, Tanya van Graan, Karl Thaning, Nicole Fortuin, Adrian Collins, Hakeem Kae-Kazim
movies.overview: LAPD officer Jake Rosser endeavors to lead a peaceful life with his family and retired K-9 officer, Socks. However, tranquility dissolves into chaos when a gang targets them in a brutal attack. Alongside his new K-9 partner Argos, Jake launches into a relentless pursuit of justice, determined to protect his loved ones.

movies.title: 9 Moons
movies.cast: Zack Gómez-Rolls, Sara Sálamo, Jorge Sanz, María León, Kiti Mánver, Fernando Guallar
movies.overview: Ángel is a personal trainer who, after taking a year off, has just landed a job at the most prestigious gym in the city, and life finally seems to be back on track. But everything changes when he begins to feel unwell, goes to the hospital, and receives shocking news: he’s pregnant. A trans man on the verge of completing his transition, Ángel is now confronted with a life-altering decision—one that will challenge his identity, his aspirations, and his very understanding of masculinity.

movies.title: Scare Out
movies.cast: Jackson Yee, Zhu Yilong, Song Jia, Lei Jiayin, Yang Mi, Zhang Yi
movies.overview: After a critical intelligence leak, a national security unit launches an intensive investigation. But successive setbacks in their arrest operations reveal a shocking truth: the trail leads back to within the unit itself. Amidst a storm of trust and betrayal, a silent battle begins to unfold...

movies.title: Husbands in Action
movies.cast: Jin Sun-kyu, Gong Myoung, Kim Ji-seok, Yoon Kyung-ho, Kang Han-na, Lee Da-hee
movies.overview: A detective teams up with his ex-wife's new husband to chase down her kidnappers. Can this unlikely duo put aside their differences for one wild rescue?

movies.title: You, Me & Tuscany
movies.cast: Halle Bailey, Regé-Jean Page, Lorenzo de Moor, Marco Calvani, Isabella Ferrari, Paolo Sassanelli
movies.overview: When a woman crashes at an empty Italian villa, posing as the owner's fiancée, she discovers an unexpected romance that could transform her life.

movies.title: Thella Kaagitham
movies.cast: Harsh Roshan, Nakshatra, Deepak Malli, Sravya Dimple, Ajay
movies.overview: Two teenagers discover first love amid the innocence, mischief, and uncertainties of adolescence. As they fall deeper for each other, the choices they make begin to carry consequences neither is prepared for.

movies.title: The Gentleman Thief
movies.cast: John Travolta, Lukas Haas, Rebecca De Mornay, Danny Pardo, Beau Bommarito, Emily Skinner
movies.overview: A retired master thief must protect his impulsive brother from disaster when a 100 million dollar yacht heist spirals into a dangerous web of deception. Old foes emerge as the stakes rise, forcing him to use every trick he knows to stay alive.

movies.title: The Mosquito Bowl
movies.cast: Nicholas Galitzine, Bill Skarsgård, Ray Nicholson, Tom Francis, Brent Comer, Jack Ingram
movies.overview: In the aftermath of Pearl Harbor, four college football stars enlist in the US Marines, discovering the strength of brotherhood and the cost of war.

movies.title: I Have a Secret
movies.cast: Daiken Okudaira, Natsuki Deguchi, Masaya Sano, Hinako Kikuchi, Hayase Ikoi, Hiccorohee
movies.overview: Kyo Otsuka is a shy high school student with zero confidence but he has feelings for Naoko Miki, the most popular girl in his class. Instead of putting himself forward, he watches her from afar as she hangs out with her energetic friends. This includes Hirofumi, Miki’s childhood friend and Kyo’s friend. Hirofumi is handsome and athletic and has a nice personality. When another shy student stops going to school, the feelings of everyone begin to change.

movies.title: Heartstopper Forever
movies.cast: Kit Connor, Joe Locke, William Gao, Yasmin Finney, Corinna Brown, Kizzy Edgell
movies.overview: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.

movies.title: Ligaw
movies.cast: Robb Guinto, Ali Asistio, JC Tan, Rash Flores, Jodi Garcia
movies.overview: A sultry woman who charms the hearts of men in a remote province. Dolores, a devoted wife to her paraplegic husband, falls for a young mountaineer. What begins as a reckless escape turns into an affair drenched in passion and secrecy.

movies.title: Korean Haunted Hospital
movies.cast: Arbani Yasiz, Elang El Gibran, Saputra Kori, Diandra Agatha, Lea Ciarachel, Jang Han-sol
movies.overview: A group of Indonesian friends travel to South Korea to live-stream a courage test inside an abandoned hospital with a dark history of cult activity, hoping to become the first to explore its supposedly haunted halls.

movies.title: DC
movies.cast: Lokesh Kanagaraj, Wamiqa Gabbi, Sanjana Krishnamoorthy, Avinash Raghudevan, Jawahar Sakthi, Sharath Ravi
movies.overview: From avenging his mother’s murder to battling police corruption, Das becomes a fugitive after a deadly heist. Amid a trail of bloodshed and loss, he frees Chandra from a life of exploitation, and she gives him a reason to seek a life beyond violence.

movies.title: Always Lalisa
movies.cast: LISA
movies.overview: Documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from BLACKPINK, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. Documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define her next chapter.

movies.title: John Candy: I Like Me
movies.cast: John Candy, Bill Murray, Chris Candy, Jennifer Candy, Steve Aker, Rose Candy
movies.overview: Those who knew iconic funnyman John Candy best share his story, in their own words, through never-before-seen archival footage, imagery, and interviews.

movies.title: Pizza Movie
movies.cast: Gaten Matarazzo, Sean Giambrone, Lulu Wilson, Jack Martin, Peyton Elizabeth Lee, Marcus Scribner
movies.overview: A group of college students go downstairs to their dorm lobby to get a delivery pizza. There's only one issue: They're insanely high on a homemade drug, turning their simple journey down two sets of stairs into a mind-bendingly transformative quest.

movies.title: ENE Repeat
movies.cast: Vishwak Sen, Abhinav Gomatam, Venkatesh Kakumanu, Maganti Srinath, Meher Ramesh, Anisha Ambrose
movies.overview: Vivek and his gang of friends embark on an attempt to create an ambitious survival film.

movies.title: A Paw Patrol Christmas
movies.cast: Luke Dietz, Lilly Bartlam, Lucien Duncan-Reid, Jesse Gervasi, Courtney Gilmour, Kai Harris
movies.overview: Rubble is looking forward to Santa bringing him a new laser drill, but finds that Santa has come down with a cold and can’t deliver any presents. When Mayor Humdinger decides he’s going to the North Pole to take all the gifts for himself, it’s up to the PAW Patrol to stop him.

movies.title: Roommates
movies.cast: Sadie Sandler, Chloe East, Billy Bryk, Sarah Sherman, Martin Herlihy, Josh Segarra
movies.overview: When shy college freshman Devon asks cool-girl Celeste to be her roommate, a blossoming friendship quickly spirals into a war of passive aggression.

movies.title: The Restoration at Grayson Manor
movies.cast: Chris Colfer, Alice Krige, Daniel Adegboyega, Declan Reynolds, Gabriela Garcia Vargas, Matthew McMahon
movies.overview: The foundations of Grayson Manor are shaken when an accident leaves Boyd Grayson handless and his mother invests in radical new technology to help him.

movies.title: Stop! That! Train!

movies.overview: Best friends and train stewardesses Tess and DeeDee trade their dreary shifts on the Stank Rail for the glitzy Glamazonian Express. However, when a catastrophic Stormaganza threatens to crash the high-speed train into Celebration, Florida, the duo in coach must join forces with the snobby first-class attendants, a hot but dimwitted co-conductor, and fabulous US President Judy Gagwell to save the day.

movies.title: The Muppet Show
movies.cast: Bill Barretta, Dave Goelz, Eric Jacobson, Peter Linz, David Rudman, Matt Vogel
movies.overview: Music, comedy, and a whole lot of chaos is bound to ensue when The Muppets once again take the stage of the original Muppet Theatre with their very special guest, Sabrina Carpenter!

movies.title: Prep & Landing: The Snowball Protocol
movies.cast: Dave Foley, Derek Richardson, Sarah Chalke, Debi Derryberry, Colleen Evanson, Manny Jacinto
movies.overview: Christmas elves Lanny and Wayne panic when their holiday missions go awry, leaving Wayne thinking he's in BIG trouble with Santa and accidentally revealing other merry mishaps.

movies.title: Colors of Evil: Black

movies.overview: Investigating the disappearance of children in a remote Polish town, prosecutor Leopold Bilski must unravel a sinister local legend before it's too late.

movies.title: A Better Jianghu

movies.overview: Two individuals, the scholar Shen Fang and the knight-errant Luo Han, steal a huge sum of silver from the official Qin Hui to support the anti-Jin rebels, devising a grand deception to combat the imperial guard and rally people from all walks of life to their cause during the Southern Song Dynasty.

movies.title: Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of the Mermaid Island
movies.original_title: 映画ちいかわ 人魚の島のひみつ
movies.cast: Haruka Aoki, Makoto Tanaka, Ari Ozawa, Yuka Iguchi, Takayuki Asai, Yuma Uchida
movies.overview: Chiikawa and friends set off on a whimsical summer adventure to a mysterious island said to hide a long-lost mermaid secret. What starts as a fun getaway quickly turns into a heartwarming journey filled with surprises, gentle thrills, and adorable chaos. With sparkling seas, strange legends, and unforgettable encounters, the trio learns about courage, friendship, and the magic hidden in small moments.

movies.title: Cerita Lila
movies.cast: Lutesha, Shareefa Daanish, Myesha Lin, Firzanah Alya, Firzanah Alya, Sara Wijayanto
movies.overview: Following a fatal history of severe maternal domestic abuse, the discarnate spirit of a young twin navigates the afterlife in a desperate search for her separated sister, uncovering a clandestine metaphysical conspiracy designed to obscure the truth of their deaths.

movies.title: Ninja Wars: BlackFox vs Shogun's Ninja
movies.cast: Chihiro Yamamoto, Kanon Miyahara, Nashiko Momotsuki, Fumi Taniguchi, Sakurako Okubo, Raiga Terasaka
movies.overview: Rikka Isurugi (Chihiro Yamamoto), head of the Fox Clan, is investigating the "White Lotus," a mysterious cult suspected of plotting a rebellion against the Shogunate. During her mission, she encounters Okyo (Kanon Miyahara), a Fuma Ninja dispatched by the Shogun. Their paths converge as they face a formidable common enemy: the Iga Ninja clan, led by Hattori Hanzo (Kane Kosugi), who harbors a deep vengeance against the Tokugawa family. A three-way conflict between the Fox Clan, Fuma Ninja, and Iga Ninja is about to begin.

movies.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
movies.cast: Rinko Kikuchi, Alberto Guerra, Alejandro Edda, YOU, Yoh Yoshida, Damián Alcázar
movies.overview: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

movies.title: Milky☆Subway: The Galactic Limited Express - the Movie
movies.original_title: 銀河特急 ミルキー☆サブウェイ 各駅停車劇場行き

movies.overview: Six delinquents are tasked with cleaning a train as part of a community service program. But when the train suddenly takes off, chaos ensues.

movies.title: Crazy Kalyanam

movies.overview: The story focuses on a village girl, played by Anupama Parameswaran, who faces struggles regarding her inability to get married, which drives the comedic and family-oriented plot.

movies.title: Fight Against Evil 3
movies.cast: Xie Miao, Lin Xiaojie, Cui Zhijia, Huang Miyi, Philip Ng Wan-lung, Ma Qianyi
movies.overview: Li Hongqi is forced to travel for his wedding but must team up with a local cop to rescue a girl from human traffickers, fighting criminals while racing against his wedding date.

movies.title: The Samurai and the Prisoner
movies.cast: Masahiro Motoki, Masaki Suda, Yuriko Yoshitaka, Munetaka Aoki, Ryota Miyadate, Tasuku Emoto
movies.overview: When Lord Murashige rises up against the tyrannical Oda, he finds himself besieged within the walls of his own castle. Isolated, he is confronted with a series of mysterious crimes that shatter the fragile order of his court, plunging the fortress into fear and suspicion. With Oda's army closing in and a traitor hiding among his ranks, Murashige is forced into an uneasy alliance with Kanbei, a brilliant and dangerous strategist held prisoner in the dungeon, as he must outwit his enemies and uncover the truth before time runs out.

movies.title: The Hotline
movies.overview: Portrait of an anonymous overdose hotline where people call before using, and volunteers stay on the line, racing against time, forging collective hope amid addiction.

movies.title: Vigilante
movies.cast: Diego Loyzaga, Robb Guinto, Vince Rillon, Archie Adamos, Raffy Tejada
movies.overview: Rider by day, vigilante by night. A grieving father seeking justice takes matters into his own hands to avenge his son's death and save the city from a crime ring.

movies.title: Hadoota
movies.cast: Ahmed Helmy, Amina Khalil, Maged Elmasry, Khaled El Sawy, Ahmed Basyoni, Omar Sherif
movies.overview: Hadoota, a 40-year-old thug, can’t remember the hiding place of an International artist he kidnapped. He resorts to hypnotherapy to retrieve this missing information. But in order to restore his memory, he needs to confront old enemies, past events, and most importantly… himself.

movies.title: Kamen Rider ZEZTZ: Farewell Mission
movies.original_title: 仮面ライダーゼッツ さよならのミッション
movies.cast: Ryutaro Imai, Yuki Furukawa, Shunta Sono, Maho Horiguchi, Kenta Mishima, Rina Onuki
movies.overview: Baku Yorozu/Kamen Rider ZEZTZ is accused of terrorism by the National Public Safety Commission. Convinced of his innocence, Kensei Odaka/Kamen Rider NOX pursues the true culprit, and finally tracks down the mastermind behind it all, National Public Safety Commission Chairman, Shuma Kumon/Kamen Rider Mugen.

movies.title: Kesong Puti
movies.cast: Apphle Celso, Van Allen Ong, Rinoa Halili, Mark Dionisio, Aya Fortes, Eddison Fernandez
movies.overview: Have a taste of VMX Newest Temptation Apphle Celso. Lena, a Kesong Puti vendor, meets a charming dairy supplier Manny. Their chemistry sparks a daring secret that transforms her humble cheese into their town’s obsession.

movies.title: Three Generations, One Christmas
movies.cast: Mario López, Tony Danza, Dominic Lopez, Taylor Kalupa, Natalia Cigliuti, William Mark McCullough
movies.overview: Set in a close-knit American town, The Starlight is a beloved local supper club and longtime community gathering place where generations have gathered to celebrate music, family, and Christmas traditions. Frank—a legendary song-and-dance man—prepares to sell the family’s beloved restaurant lounge after 40 years. With the future of The Starlight in question, three generations of family are drawn into an emotional journey that reminds them what is worth preserving — and how faith, family, and home can quietly lead us back to where we belong.

movies.title: Modha Rathri
movies.cast: Rishikanth, Anishma Anilkumar, Chetan, A. Venkatesh, Bagavathi Perumal, Sangeetha Balan
movies.overview: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

movies.title: Sugar Mommy
movies.cast: Jamilla Obispo, Ashley Lopez, Aerol Carmelo, Rash Flores
movies.overview: When a non-committal sugar mommy takes in her three sugar babies, jealousy erupts as one of them becomes determined to be her one and only.

movies.title: Kudrat 1968: High Council
movies.cast: Zarif Ghazzi, Mierul Aiman, Dai Fuad, Akmal Asyraf, Chech Harith, Evertts Gomes
movies.overview: When Abbas returned to KUDRAT, the school was suddenly besieged by authorities following the death of a student, a tragedy the administration had long kept hidden. Tensions between the elite students and the scholarship students reached a breaking point. While Piji was determined to bring down Pa, Abbas and Kuda fought to uphold justice and expose the dark secrets threatening the entire institution.

movies.title: Ben Sana İnanıyorum
movies.cast: Mahsun Karaca, Mahir İpek, Levent Ülgen, Mine Kılıç, Gürhan Altundaşar, Gülhan Tekin
movies.overview: Eager to land prestigious clients, Mahsun, an ambitious lawyer puts up an online ad, only to end up saddled with a ruthless crime boss confined to house arrest. Dragged headfirst into dangerous underworld chaos, he must scramble to rid himself of his unwanted client before his career and life completely unravel.

movies.title: The Militia
movies.cast: Sam Williamson, Michael Broderick, Luke Stratte-McClure, Chris Bylsma, Laurel Feierbach, Solomon Puckett
movies.overview: Daniel Pierce dreams of joining the local Militia alongside his father once he turns eighteen, but when his Dad becomes the target of the local Sheriff, Daniel and his friends form their own militia in a troubled effort to save him.

movies.title: Confession
movies.cast: Rob Lowe, James Franco, Jennifer Jason Leigh, Kodi Smit-McPhee, Nick Nolte, Richard Brake
movies.overview: In 1938, in Stalin's Moscow, a disillusioned professor, Alexei, faces brutal interrogation by his former student, Vladimir, in Lubyanka Prison. Refusing to confess, he confronts his past sins and finds redemption through faith, sacrificing himself to save others in a haunting tale of morality and resistance.

movies.title: Center Stage for Murder
movies.cast: Krystal Ellsworth, Stephen Tracey, Helene Henry, Brandon Keith Rogers, Tiffany Shepis, Rachel Pizzolato
movies.overview: After suffering a tragic accident, a ballerina finds safety, comfort and intimacy in the arms of her physical therapist. However, she soon becomes a prisoner in her own home when she discovers he's the one responsible for her injury.

movies.title: Threesome

movies.title: Talk to Her
movies.cast: Javier Cámara, Darío Grandinetti, Leonor Watling, Rosario Flores, Mariola Fuentes, Geraldine Chaplin
movies.overview: Two men share an odd friendship while they care for two women who are both in deep comas.

movies.cast: Jamie Bell, Gary Lewis, Julie Walters, Jean Heywood, Jamie Draven, Stuart Wells
movies.country: France, United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: County Durham, England, 1984. The miners' strike has started and the police have started coming up from Bethnal Green, starting a class war with the lower classes suffering. Caught in the middle of the conflict is 11-year old Billy Elliot, who, after leaving his boxing club for the day, stumbles upon a ballet class and finds out that he's naturally talented. He practices with his teacher Mrs. Wilkinson for an upcoming audition in Newcastle-upon Tyne for the royal Ballet school in London.

movies.title: Anatomy of a Murder
movies.cast: James Stewart, Lee Remick, Ben Gazzara, Arthur O'Connell, Eve Arden, Kathryn Grant
movies.overview: Semi-retired Michigan lawyer Paul Biegler takes the case of Army Lt. Manion, who murdered a local innkeeper after his wife claimed that he raped her. movies.overview: Brantley Foster, a well-educated kid from Kansas, has always dreamed of making it big in New York City, but once there, he learns that jobs - and girls - are hard to get. When he visits his uncle, Howard Prescott, who runs a multi-million-dollar company, he is given a job in the mail room.

movies.title: Just My Luck
movies.cast: Lindsay Lohan, Chris Pine, Samaire Armstrong, Bree Turner, Faizon Love, Missi Pyle
movies.overview: Manhattanite Ashley is known to many as the luckiest woman around. After a chance encounter with a down-and-out young man, however, she realizes that she's swapped her fortune for his.

movies.title: Unleashed
movies.cast: Jet Li, Morgan Freeman, Bob Hoskins, Kerry Condon, Vincent Regan, Dylan Brown
movies.country: China, France, United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: Raised as a slave, Danny is used to fighting for his survival. In fact, his "master," Bart, thinks of him as a pet and goes as far as leashing him with a collar so they can make money in fight clubs, where Danny is the main contender. When Bart's crew is in a car accident, Danny escapes and meets a blind, kindhearted piano tuner who takes him in and uses music to free the fighter's long-buried heart.

movies.title: Honey
movies.cast: Jessica Alba, Mekhi Phifer, Romeo, Joy Bryant, David Moscow, Lonette McKee
movies.overview: Honey Daniels dreams of making a name for herself as a hip-hop choreographer. When she's not busy hitting downtown clubs with her friends, she teaches dance classes at a nearby community center in Harlem, N.Y., as a way to keep kids off the streets. Honey thinks she's hit the jackpot when she meets a hotshot director casts her in one of his music videos. But, when he starts demanding sexual favors from her, Honey makes a decision that will change her life.

movies.title: Just Friends
movies.cast: Ryan Reynolds, Amy Smart, Anna Faris, Chris Klein, Christopher Rodriguez Marquette, Julie Hagerty
movies.overview: While visiting his hometown during Christmas, a man comes face-to-face with his old high school crush whom he was best friends with – a woman whose rejection of him turned him into a ferocious womanizer.

movies.title: Miss Congeniality 2: Armed and Fabulous
movies.cast: Sandra Bullock, Regina King, Enrique Murciano, Ernie Hudson, William Shatner, Heather Burns
movies.overview: After her triumph at the Miss United States pageant, FBI agent Gracie Hart becomes an overnight sensation — and the new "face of the FBI". But it's time to spring into action again when the pageant's winner, Cheryl, and emcee, Stan, are abducted.

movies.title: District B13
movies.cast: David Belle, Cyril Raffaelli, Tony D'Amario, Dany Verissimo-Petit, Bibi Naceri, Nicolas Woirion
movies.overview: Set in the ghettos of Paris in 2010, an undercover cop and ex-thug try to infiltrate a gang in order to defuse a neutron bomb.

movies.title: Stealth
movies.cast: Josh Lucas, Jessica Biel, Jamie Foxx, Sam Shepard, Joe Morton, Ebon Moss-Bachrach
movies.overview: Deeply ensconced in a top-secret military program, three pilots struggle to bring an artificial intelligence program under control ... before it initiates the next world war.

movies.title: Dragonfly
movies.cast: Kevin Costner, Joe Morton, Ron Rifkin, Susanna Thompson, Kathy Bates, Jacob Smith
movies.overview: A grieving doctor is being contacted by his late wife through his patient's near death experiences.

movies.title: When a Stranger Calls
movies.cast: Camilla Belle, Tommy Flanagan, Katie Cassidy, Tessa Thompson, Brian Geraghty, Clark Gregg
movies.overview: Far away from the site of a gruesome murder, a teenager named Jill Johnson arrives at a luxurious home for a baby-sitting job. With the children fast asleep, she settles in for what she expects to be an ordinary evening. Soon, the ringing of a phone and the frightening words of a sadistic caller turn Jill's routine experience into a night of terror.

movies.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
movies.cast: 50 Cent, Joy Bryant, Adewale Akinnuoye-Agbaje, Omar Benson Miller, Terrence Howard, Viola Davis
movies.overview: A tale of an inner city drug dealer who turns away from crime to pursue his passion, rap music.

movies.title: Hot Rod
movies.cast: Andy Samberg, Isla Fisher, Jorma Taccone, Bill Hader, Danny McBride, Chris Parnell
movies.overview: For Rod Kimble, performing stunts is a way of life, even though he is rather accident-prone. Poor Rod cannot even get any respect from his stepfather, Frank, who beats him up in weekly sparring matches. When Frank falls ill, Rod devises his most outrageous stunt yet to raise money for Frank's operation -- and then Rod will kick Frank's butt.

movies.title: A Sound of Thunder
movies.cast: Edward Burns, Catherine McCormack, Ben Kingsley, William Armstrong, Jemima Rooper, David Oyelowo
movies.country: Czech Republic, Germany, Switzerland, United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: When a hunter sent back to the prehistoric era runs off the path he must not leave, he causes a chain reaction that alters history in disastrous ways.

movies.overview_source_for_fa: When a hunter sent back to the prehistoric era runs off the path he must not leave, he causes a chain reaction that alters history in disastrous ways.

movies.overview: Navy Lt. Tom Farrell meets a young woman, Susan Atwell, and they share a passionate fling. Farrell then finds out that his superior, Defense Secretary David Brice, is also romantically involved with Atwell. When the young woman turns up dead, Farrell is put in charge of the murder investigation. He begins to uncover shocking clues about the case, but when details of his encounter with Susan surface, he becomes a suspect as well.

movies.cast: Jean-Claude Van Damme, Deborah Richter, Vincent Klyn, Alex Daniels, Ralf Moeller, Dayle Haddon
movies.overview: A martial artist hunts a killer in a plague-infested urban dump of the future.

movies.overview_source_for_fa: A martial artist hunts a killer in a plague-infested urban dump of the future.

movies.title: Road House
movies.cast: Patrick Swayze, Kelly Lynch, Sam Elliott, Ben Gazzara, Marshall R. Teague, Julie Michaels
movies.overview: The Double Deuce is the meanest, loudest and rowdiest bar south of the Mason-Dixon Line, and Dalton has been hired to clean it up. He might not look like much, but the Ph.D.-educated bouncer proves he's more than capable – busting the heads of troublemakers and turning the roadhouse into a jumping hot spot. But Dalton's romance with the gorgeous Dr. Clay puts him on the bad side of cutthroat local big shot Brad Wesley.

movies.title: Milk
movies.cast: Sean Penn, Emile Hirsch, Josh Brolin, Diego Luna, James Franco, Alison Pill
movies.overview: The true story of Harvey Milk, the first openly gay man ever elected to public office. In San Francisco in the late 1970s, Harvey Milk becomes an activist for gay rights and inspires others to join him in his fight for equal rights that should be available to all Americans.

movies.title: Dirty Rotten Scoundrels
movies.cast: Steve Martin, Michael Caine, Glenne Headly, Anton Rodgers, Barbara Harris, Ian McDiarmid
movies.overview: Con artist Lawrence Jamieson is a longtime resident of a luxurious coastal resort, where he enjoys the lavish fruits of his deceptions -- that is, until a competitor, Freddy Benson, shows up. When the new guy's lowbrow tactics impinge on his own sophisticated work and believing him to be the infamous conman 'The Jackal', Lawrence resolves to get rid of him. Confident of his own duplicitous talents, he challenges Freddy to a winner-takes-all competition: whoever swindles their latest mark, American heiress Janet Colgate, out of $50,000 first can stay, while the other must leave town.

movies.title: The Last Unicorn
movies.cast: Mia Farrow, Alan Arkin, Tammy Grimes, Jeff Bridges, Christopher Lee, Angela Lansbury
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: A unicorn learns from a riddle-speaking butterfly that she is supposedly the last of her kind, all the others having been herded away by the monstrous Red Bull. The unicorn sets out to discover the truth behind the butterfly's words. She is eventually joined on her quest by Schmendrick, a second-rate magician, and Molly Grue, a middle-aged woman who dreamed all her life of seeing a unicorn. Their journey leads them far from home, all the way to the castle of King Haggard.

movies.title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd
movies.original_title: Dumb and Dumberer: When Harry Met Lloyd

movies.cast: Derek Richardson, Eric Christian Olsen, Mimi Rogers, Luis Guzmán, Rachel Nichols, Eugene Levy
movies.overview: This wacky prequel to the 1994 blockbuster goes back to the lame-brained Harry and Lloyd's days as classmates at a Rhode Island high school, where the unprincipled principal puts the pair in remedial courses as part of a scheme to fleece the school.

movies.title: Sphere
movies.cast: Dustin Hoffman, Sharon Stone, Samuel L. Jackson, Peter Coyote, Liev Schreiber, Queen Latifah
movies.overview: A spacecraft is discovered at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean, presumed to be at least 300 years old and of alien origin. A crack team of scientists and experts is assembled and taken to the ocean floor to investigate. However, the ship is not as it seems and when a giant perfect sphere is discovered in the cargo bay, things begin to fall apart.

movies.title: U Turn
movies.cast: Sean Penn, Nick Nolte, Jennifer Lopez, Joaquin Phoenix, Claire Danes, Powers Boothe
movies.overview: When a desperate man’s car breaks down in a bizarre desert town while evading vengeful bookies, he becomes entangled in a dangerous love triangle. Caught between a married couple, he’s faced with deadly contracts to kill them both.

movies.title: White Men Can't Jump
movies.cast: Woody Harrelson, Wesley Snipes, Rosie Perez, Tyra Ferrell, Cylk Cozart, Marques Johnson
movies.overview: Two street basketball hustlers try to con each other, then team up for a bigger score.

movies.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street: The Dream Child
movies.original_title: A Nightmare on Elm Street: The Dream Child
movies.cast: Lisa Wilcox, Robert Englund, Danny Hassel, Kelly Jo Minter, Erika Anderson, Nicholas Mele
movies.overview: The pregnant Alice finds Freddy Krueger striking through the sleeping mind of her unborn child, hoping to be reborn into the real world.

movies.title: My Left Foot: The Story of Christy Brown
movies.original_title: My Left Foot: The Story of Christy Brown
movies.cast: Daniel Day-Lewis, Brenda Fricker, Alison Whelan, Kirsten Sheridan, Declan Croghan, Eanna MacLiam
movies.overview: No one expects much from Christy Brown, a boy with cerebral palsy born into a working-class Irish family. Though Christy is a spastic quadriplegic and essentially paralyzed, a miraculous event occurs when, at the age of 5, he demonstrates control of his left foot by using chalk to scrawl a word on the floor. With the help of his steely mother — and no shortage of grit and determination — Christy overcomes his infirmity to become a painter, poet and author.

movies.title: The Witches
movies.cast: Jasen Fisher, Mai Zetterling, Anjelica Huston, Charlie Potter, Rowan Atkinson, Bill Paterson
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: While staying at a hotel in England with his grandmother, Helga, a young boy named Luke inadvertently spies on a convention of witches. The Grand High Witch reveals a plan to turn all children into mice via a magical formula. When they discover the eavesdropper, the witches test the formula on him. Now, with the help of Helga and hotel manager Mr Stringer, Luke the mouse must fight back against the witches.

movies.title: Are We Done Yet?
movies.cast: Ice Cube, Nia Long, John C. McGinley, Aleisha Allen, Philip Bolden, Jonathan Katz
movies.overview: Newlyweds Nick and Suzanne decide to move to the suburbs to provide a better life for their two kids. But their idea of a dream home is disturbed by a contractor with a bizarre approach to business.

movies.title: Nine
movies.cast: Daniel Day-Lewis, Marion Cotillard, Penélope Cruz, Nicole Kidman, Judi Dench, Sophia Loren
movies.overview: Arrogant, self-centered movie director Guido Contini finds himself struggling to find meaning, purpose, and a script for his latest film endeavor. With only a week left before shooting begins, he desperately searches for answers and inspiration from his wife, his mistress, his muse, and his mother.

movies.title: The Tale of Despereaux
movies.cast: Matthew Broderick, Dustin Hoffman, Emma Watson, Tracey Ullman, Kevin Kline, Sigourney Weaver
movies.country: United Kingdom, United States of America
movies.overview: Once upon a time... in the far away kingdom of Dor... lived a brave and virtuous mouse with comically oversized ears who dreamt of becoming a knight. Banished from his home for having such lofty ambitions, Despereaux sets off on an amazing adventure with his good-hearted rat friend Roscuro, who leads him, at long last, on a very noble quest to rescue an endangered princess and save an entire kingdom from darkness.
movies.overview_fa: سال‌های سال قبل، در سرزمینی با زیبایی هوش‌ربا، انسان‌ها غرق در شادی و خوشبختی زندگی می‌کردند. تا اینکه یک ‏روز به دنبال واقعه‌ای دور از انتظار، دل پادشاه این سرزمین می‌شکند. شاهزاده اسیر اندوه و مردم دستخوش نا‌امیدی ‏می‌شوند. زندگی دیگر روال سابق را ندارد، البته تا وقتی که دسپرو متولد شود. موشی کوچک با گوش‌هایی بسیار ‏بزرگ که از تمام موش‌ها جسورتر است. از چاقو، تله موش و گربه نمی‌ترسد و بسیار هم کنجکاو است، چون از ‏لحظه تولد شروع به گشتن و یافتن کرده و می‌خواهد از هر چیزی سر در بیاورد. از طرف دیگر عطشی سیری‌ناپذیر به ‏ماجرا و هیجان او دیده می‌شود و همین باعث می‌شود تا یک روز سر از کتابخانه شاهی در آورد. در آنجا خواندن را ‏یاد گرفته و کتاب‌ها او را به دنیاهای تازه ای رهنمون می‌سازند…

movies.overview: A woman finds a romantic letter in a bottle washed ashore and tracks down the author, a widowed shipbuilder whose wife died tragically early. As a deep and mutual attraction blossoms, the man struggles to make peace with his past so that he can move on and find happiness.

movies.title: Species II
movies.cast: Natasha Henstridge, Michael Madsen, Marg Helgenberger, Mykelti Williamson, Justin Lazard, James Cromwell
movies.overview: Having just returned from a mission to Mars, Commander Ross isn't exactly himself. He's slowly becoming a terrifying alien entity with one goal -- to procreate with human women! When countless women suffer gruesome deaths after bearing half-alien offspring, scientist Laura Baker and hired assassin Press Lennox use Eve, a more tempered alien clone, to find Ross and his brood. Before long Eve escapes to mate with Ross.

movies.title: Swingers
movies.cast: Jon Favreau, Vince Vaughn, Ron Livingston, Patrick Van Horn, Alex Désert, Heather Graham
movies.overview: After 6 years together, Mike's girlfriend leaves him, so he travels to LA to be a star. Six months on, he's still not doing very well— so a few of his friends try to reconnect him to the social scene and hopefully help him forget his failed relationship.

movies.title: A Simple Plan
movies.cast: Bill Paxton, Billy Bob Thornton, Bridget Fonda, Brent Briscoe, Chelcie Ross, Gary Cole
movies.country: United States of America, United Kingdom, France, Japan, Germany
movies.overview: Captivated by the lure of sudden wealth, the quiet rural lives of two brothers erupt into conflicts of greed, paranoia and distrust when over $4 million in cash is discovered at the remote site of a downed small airplane. Their simple plan to retain the money while avoiding detection opens a Pandora's box when the fear of getting caught triggers panicked behavior and leads to virulent consequences.
